src: Des affrontements violents opposant les groupes armés Twirwaneho et Wazalendo dirigés par Ebuela Seba alias Mtetezi, ont été signalés depuis la matinée de ce lundi 03 Mars 2025 dans le village de Mikenge
Après l’occupation de Mikenge,les wazalendo ont incendié dans la mi-journée le Camp des déplacés internes qui hébergait en majorité les membres de la communauté banyamulenge.
aucune source n’a confirmé de bilan humain précis, bien que des victimes soient à déplorer de part et d’autre.

r1-SKS-2025Q1-014.s: Kivutimes reported that the NGO New Hope Réconciliation Centre called on humanitarian organisations to help victims of the attacks that targeted the Mikenge displaced camp, which the article described as a devastating attack carried out by Mai Mai armed groups called Wazalendo, and that the camp, which housed about 310 households mainly of Banyamulenge families, was reduced to a heap of ashes.
r1-SKS-2025Q1-014.l: Mikenge IDP camp, Itombwe, Mwenga territory
r1-SKS-2025Q1-014.a: Wazalendo (Mai Mai), as described in the Kivutimes article on the NHRC appeal
r1-SKS-2025Q1-014.x: NHRC/Kivutimes: about 310 households in the camp; 'thousands of families' left homeless; casualty figure not given
r1-SKS-2025Q1-014.n: Date is the publication date (13 Mar); the attack date is not on this page (Kivutimes 4 Mar places the burning on 3 Mar). The page also says, per local sources, the attacks caused significant loss of life and looting; not quantified, not excerpted.
r1-SKS-2025Q1-014.vn: Narrowed attribution: the excerpt's grammar makes the Wazalendo description and the 310 figure the article's narration, not explicitly NHRC's statement. The page does not say whether the Wazalendo attribution and the 310-household figure come from NHRC or from Kivutimes's own reporting; they are credited here to the article. Attack date not on this page (Kivutimes 4 Mar places the burning on 3 Mar).
src: L’organisation humanitaire New Hope Réconciliation Centre appelle les organisations humanitaires à intervenir afin de venir en aide aux victimes des attaques qui ont ciblé le camp des déplacés de Mikenge, une attaque dévastatrice menée par des groupes armés Mai Mai appelés Wazalendo.
Le camp de déplacés de Mikenge, qui abritait environ 310 ménages principalement composés de familles Banyamulenge, a été réduit à un tas de cendres.

r1-SKS-2025Q1-015.s: Radio Okapi reported that fighting between the armed groups Red Tabara and Wazalendo was reported on Thursday 20 March in Fizi territory, South Kivu, that people of the Minembwe Hauts Plateaux were fleeing toward Fizi centre, and that the territory administrator confirmed this, appealed to the belligerents to end hostilities and invited humanitarian organisations to assist thousands of displaced people.
r1-SKS-2025Q1-015.l: Hauts Plateaux de Minembwe to Fizi centre, Fizi territory
r1-SKS-2025Q1-015.x: 'thousands of displaced' (Radio Okapi, per the territory administrator's appeal)
r1-SKS-2025Q1-015.n: The territory administrator's statement is reported without a name; Fizi territory administrator unnamed on the page.
r1-SKS-2025Q1-015.vn: Verbatim on Radio Okapi page (published 20/03/2025 22:59). Administrator unnamed.
src: Des combats ont été signalés, ce jeudi 20 mars, entre les groupes armés Red Tabara et Wazalendo dans le territoire de Fizi au Sud-Kivu. Les populations des Hauts Plateaux de Minembwe fuient leurs villages en direction de Fizi centre.

Cette information corroborée par des sources concordantes est confirmée par l'administrateur de territoire. Ce dernier lance un appel aux belligérants pour mettre fin aux hostilités. Il invite les organisations humanitaires à apporter une assistance aux milliers de déplacés.

r1-SKS-2025Q1-016.s: Radio Okapi reported that fighting resumed in the Minembwe Hauts Plateaux between the FARDC supported by Wazalendo fighters and the coalition of the armed groups Twirwaneho and Gumino, and, according to the Fizi territory administrator, that the FARDC supported by Wazalendo militiamen launched an assault on the coalition's positions.
r1-SKS-2025Q1-016.l: Minembwe Hauts Plateaux: Mukoko toward Kakenge; earlier Gahwera and Kivumu
r1-SKS-2025Q1-016.a: FARDC and Wazalendo; Twirwaneho and Gumino coalition
r1-SKS-2025Q1-016.n: Page also reports fighting on the previous day (20 Mar) at several villages, notably Gahwera and Kivumu.
r1-SKS-2025Q1-016.vn: Verbatim on Radio Okapi page (published 21/03/2025). Location detail (Mukoko, Kakenge, Gahwera, Kivumu) is on the same page (Nyarugabo tweet; 'La veille ... Gahwera et Kivumu').
src: Les combats ont repris dans les hauts plateaux de Minembwe , dans la province du Sud-Kivu. Ces affrontements opposent les Forces armées de la République démocratique du Congo (FARDC) appuyés par les combattants Wazalendo à la coalition des groupes armés Twirwaneho et Gumino, actifs dans la région.
Selon l’administrateur du territoire de Fizi, les FARDC, appuyées par les miliciens Wazalendo, ont lancé un assaut sur les positions de la coalition Twirwaneho et Gumino.

r1-SKS-2025Q1-017.s: Radio Okapi reported, citing several concordant sources, that the rural town of Kamanyola, in Walungu territory, had been under occupation by the M23 and their Rwandan allies since Tuesday 18 February, late in the evening.
r1-SKS-2025Q1-017.l: Kamanyola, Walungu territory (Ruzizi plain border with Rwanda and Burundi)
r1-SKS-2025Q1-017.a: M23 and their Rwandan allies, per Radio Okapi
r1-SKS-2025Q1-017.n: Corroborates BBC Gahuza r1-SKN-2025Q1-010 (M23 entered Kamanyola Tuesday night). Page says Kamanyola is in Walungu territory; it is the access to Uvira and Fizi.
r1-SKS-2025Q1-017.vn: Verbatim on Radio Okapi page (published 19/02/2025); 'M23 and their Rwandan allies' is Radio Okapi's wording citing several concordant sources.
src: La cité rurale de Kamanyola, dans le territoire de Walungu, au Sud-Kivu, est sous occupation des rebelles M23 et de leurs alliés rwandais, depuis mardi 18 février, tard dans la soirée, selon plusieurs sources concordantes.

r1-SKS-2025Q1-018.s: Agence France-Presse reported that military and official sources said Burundian troops were being discreetly withdrawn despite official denials; a senior officer told AFP 'Nous avions érigé une ligne de défense à Kamanyola' to try to stop the advance of the M23 and Rwandan soldiers but had to make a tactical retreat under enemy attack on Tuesday, adding that part of 'our troops' deployed in eastern DRC were returning home on foot, which a senior Burundian official confirmed to AFP.
r1-SKS-2025Q1-018.a: Burundian troops (per anonymous military and official sources to AFP) vs M23 and Rwandan soldiers
r1-SKS-2025Q1-018.n: Anonymous military and official sources; Burundi officially denied withdrawing (see existing claim citing Anadolu, r1 aa.com.tr). Date computed from 'hier [mardi]' and page date 19 Feb 2025 (Wednesday), so 18 Feb.
r1-SKS-2025Q1-018.vn: The page calls the speaker 'un haut gradé' only; his Burundian affiliation is implied by context (Bujumbura withdrawing, 'nos troupes ... regagner le pays'). Statement now carries the article's own framing and the denial. Grade C: anonymous sources. Anonymous sources to AFP; Burundi officially denied withdrawing, and the article itself notes 'les démentis officiels'. Both accounts kept.
src: « Nous avions érigé une ligne de défense à Kamanyola pour essayer d’arrêter l’avancée du M23 et des soldats rwandais, mais nous avons dû opérer un repli tactique sous l’attaque ennemie hier [mardi] », a dit à l’AFP un haut gradé.
Depuis, « une partie de nos troupes déployées dans l’est de la RDC sont en train de regagner le pays à pied », a-t-il ajouté. Cette information a été confirmée par un haut cadre burundais à l’AFP.

r1-SKS-2025Q1-019.s: MediaCongo, relaying nouveaumedia.cd / MCP, reported that, after the capture of Kamanyola, the M23 and allies of the Rwandan army were said to have taken the villages of Luvungi and Sange, a few kilometres from Uvira, causing panic in Uvira where shops closed and some people crossed the border into Burundi, and that clashes between uncontrolled elements of the army and Wazalendo were said to have killed civilians.
r1-SKS-2025Q1-019.a: M23 and allies of the Rwandan army; uncontrolled army elements and Wazalendo (clashes)
r1-SKS-2025Q1-019.n: Conditional tense ('auraient'); early report. Byline Hornella MANSANGA, credit 'nouveaumedia.cd / MCP, via mediacongo'.
r1-SKS-2025Q1-019.vn: All passages verbatim; credit line 'nouveaumedia.cd / MCP, via mediacongo' (byline Hornella MANSANGA). Conditional ('auraient') kept; no toll or names given.
src: Aux dernières nouvelles, le M23 et alliés de l’armée rwandaise auraient pris les villages de Luvungi et Sange situés à quelques kilomètres de la ville d’Uvira. Ce qui aurait remonté la psychose parmi la population et les habitants d’Uvira.

Magasins et autres commerces fermés, certains, pris de panique, cherchent un abri. D’autres n’hésitent pas d’effectuer des longues distances jusqu’à traverser la frontière pour se réfugier au Burundi voisin.
Mais les combats entre les éléments incontrôlés de l’armée loyale et Wazalendo auraient fait des morts parmi les civils.

r1-SKS-2025Q1-020.s: Radio Okapi reported that honorary senator Moïse Nyarugabo, in a tweet on Friday 21 March, said that since 6h that morning the FARDC and Wazalendo, coming from Fizi via Mukela and Mulima, had resumed their attack at Mukoko toward Kakenge, and that the inhabitants of the Fizi and Mwenga Hauts Plateaux, especially Minembwe, were again waking up under bombs.
r1-SKS-2025Q1-020.l: Mukoko toward Kakenge, Minembwe Hauts Plateaux, Fizi/Mwenga
r1-SKS-2025Q1-020.a: FARDC and Wazalendo; Twirwaneho and Gumino coalition
r1-SKS-2025Q1-020.n: Post by an individual politician as relayed by Radio Okapi; evidence of what he said. Original tweet not opened.
r1-SKS-2025Q1-020.vn: Verbatim on Radio Okapi page (21/03/2025). Statement by an individual politician as reported by Radio Okapi; the original tweet was not opened.
src: le sénateur honoraire Moïse Nyarugabo a confirmé ces informations : « Les habitants des hauts-plateaux de Fizi et Mwenga , en particulier ceux de Minembwe se réveillent encore sous les bombes. Depuis 6h ce matin du 21/03/25, les mêmes FARDC et Wazalendo venus de Fizi par Mukela et Mulima viennent de reprendre leur attaque a Mukoko en direction de Kakenge

r1-SKS-2025Q2-001.s: Kivu Morning Post reported that intense fighting had been reported since the morning of Friday 9 May 2025 in Fizi territory, between AFC-M23 rebels allied to Twirwaneho and Wazalendo at Rugezi, sector of Mutambala; Wazalendo spokesperson Aimable Nabulizi said Wazalendo of the Biloze Bishambuke self-defence force of General Ngomanzo were attacking Rugezi.
r1-SKS-2025Q2-001.l: Rugezi, Basimukuma Sud, Mutambala sector, Fizi
r1-SKS-2025Q2-001.a: Wazalendo (Biloze Bishambuke, Gen. Ngomanzo) vs AFC-M23/Twirwaneho/Red Tabara, as stated by a Wazalendo spokesperson
r1-SKS-2025Q2-001.n: Local outlet, Bukavu/Goma; one Wazalendo spokesperson is the only attribution. Spelling Ngomanzo here, Ngomanzito/NGOMANZITO in other KMP and SOS pieces.
r1-SKS-2025Q2-001.vn: Page checked (retained copy): excerpts exact and on this event; date printed. excerpt_en flag is sentence-initial words only. Single Goma outlet relaying a party spokesperson: C. The Wazalendo advance is claimed by the Wazalendo spokesperson ('selon la même source, qui revendique l’avancée des Wazalendo'). The commander's name is printed 'Ngomanzo' here and 'NGOMANZITO' in other Kivu Morning Post and SOS Médias Burundi pieces.
src: Des affrontements intenses sont signalés depuis la matinée de ce vendredi 09 mai 2025 dans le territoire de Fizi, en province du Sud-Kivu. Ces combats opposent les rebelles de l’AFC-M23, alliés au Twirwaneho, et les Wazalendo à Rugezi, dans le secteur de Mutambala, groupement Basimukuma Sud.

“Les Wazalendo de la force d’auto-défense Biloze Bishambuke du Général Ngomanzo mènent des farouches attaques ce matin à Rugezi contre la coalition de l’AFC/Twirwaneho/M23 et le Red Tabara,” a déclaré Aimable Nabulizi, porte-parole des Wazalendo dans la zone.

r1-SKS-2025Q2-002.s: BBC News Gahuza reported that M23 fighters were said to have taken Katogota on Thursday, 80 km north of Uvira city; Uvira resident Elias Muhasha told the BBC that M23 fighters took Katogota after heavy fighting that began on Wednesday; the M23 side neither confirmed nor denied reaching Katogota, but social-media video posted on Thursday showed some M23 fighters indicating they were in Katogota.
r1-SKS-2025Q2-002.a: M23, as reported by BBC Gahuza
r1-SKS-2025Q2-002.n: Single resident quoted; M23 neither confirmed nor denied. Date computed from weekday ('ku wa kane' = Thursday) and publication date 9 May 2025 (Friday); Thursday = 2025-05-08. Distance 80 km as printed. Existing claim r1-UV-2025Q2-018 covers 5-6 May fighting at Katogota (Radio Okapi).
r1-SKS-2025Q2-002.vn: Kinyarwanda checked against the retained page: 'ku wa kane' = Thursday, 'ku wa gatatu' = Wednesday, 'ku ntera ya kilometero 80' = at a distance of 80 km (the draft's 'about' is not in the source; removed). Translations of the three excerpts are faithful. Date computed: the article is dated 9 May 2025 (a Friday) and says 'ku wa kane' (Thursday), so 8 May 2025 is approximate. 'bivugwa ko' = 'it is said that': the capture is reported, not confirmed.
src: Elias Muhasha umwe mu baturage bari i Uvira yabwiye BBC ko abarwanyi ba M23 bafashe Katogota nyuma y'imirwano ikomeye yatangiye ku wa gatatu.
Uruhande rwa M23 ntirwemeje cyangwa ngo ruhakane ko bageze i Katogota, gusa amwe mu mashusho yashyizwe ku mbuga nkoranyambaga ku wa kane yerekana bamwe mu barwanyi ba M23 berekana ko bari i Katogota.
abarwanyi ba M23 bivugwa ko ku wa kane bafashe agace ka Katogota kari ku ntera ya kilometero 80 mu majyaruguru uvuye mu mujyi wa Uvira.

r1-SKS-2025Q2-003.s: BBC News Gahuza reported that from the morning of Friday heavy fighting was reported at Lugezi/Rugezi, Basimukuma-Sud grouping, Fizi, between Wazalendo and Twirwaneho fighters, and that many civilians fled; a Fizi resident who did not wish to be named told the BBC when the fighting began; some people were said to have been killed, but their number and the number of displaced civilians were hard to establish; local journalists said Wazalendo of the Biloze Bishambuke group were the ones fighting Twirwaneho fighters.
r1-SKS-2025Q2-003.n: Independent of the Kivu Morning Post claim above (own sourcing); corroborates date and parties.
r1-SKS-2025Q2-003.vn: Draft cited the anonymous resident for the whole account; the page cites him only for the start time. Restored the source's 'some were said to have died' hedge. Removed the day number (not in any excerpt; date field carries 2025-05-09). Independent of the Kivu Morning Post claim (own sourcing): B for the fact of fighting. The article is dated 9 May 2025; 'uyu wa gatanu' = this Friday. The resident gave the start time as about 5 a.m. ('saa kumi n'imwe z'igitondo').
src: Biravugwa ko hari abaguye muri iyi mirwano ariko biragoye kumenya imibare yabo cyangwa imibare y'abasivile bavuye mu byabo.
Abanyamakuru bo muri aka gace baremeza ko mu mirwano ya Lugezi/Rugezi kuri uyu wa gatanu Wazalendo bo mu mutwe wa Biloze Bishambuke ari bo barimo kurwana n'abarwanyi ba Twirwaneho.

r1-SKS-2025Q2-004.s: Kivu Morning Post quoted a communiqué of the Twirwaneho (MRDP-Twirwaneho) saying that the Rurambo region had been violently attacked by government forces in coalition with Burundian troops and Wazalendo elements, that these acts deliberately targeted Banyamulenge civilians, and that it would take all necessary defensive and offensive measures; in the same article Wazalendo spokesperson Aimable Nabulizi said intense fighting had been reported at Rugezi since the morning of Monday 19 May 2025, where the Wazalendo of General NGOMANZITO faced AFC Twirwaneho M23 rebels.
r1-SKS-2025Q2-004.a: MRDP-Twirwaneho (party statement); Wazalendo of Gen. Ngomanzito
r1-SKS-2025Q2-004.n: Twirwaneho is a party; its accusation is cited only as what it said (partisan_twirwaneho); the outlet reproduces it in quotation marks and the page attributes it to 'le Twirwaneho' in a communiqué. Counter-account to the FARDC/Wazalendo account.
r1-SKS-2025Q2-004.vn: Two attribution fixes: the Rugezi sentence is the Wazalendo spokesperson's quote, not the outlet's own attribution; and the page does not date the communiqué to 19 May, so the date now attaches only to the fighting Nabulizi described. The 'defensive and offensive measures' clause is on the page, outside the stored excerpt (excerpt gap). excerpt_en flag: sentence-initial word only. Party statements on both sides. The communiqué is undated on the page; it appears in the article of 19 May 2025. Its 'actes de guerre' wording is the Twirwaneho's own.
src: “La région de Rurambo a été violemment attaquée par les forces gouvernementales en coalition avec des troupes burundaises ainsi que des éléments Wazalendo. Ces actes de guerre ciblent délibérément les civils Banyamulenge

“D’intenses affrontements sont signalés à RUGEZI depuis le matin de ce lundi 19 mai 2025, où les Wazalendo du Général NGOMANZITO font face aux rebelles de l’AFC Twirwaneho M23”, a déclaré Aimable Nabulizi, porte-parole des Wazalendo dans la zone.

r1-SKS-2025Q2-005.s: Kivu Morning Post reported that Wazalendo fighters allied to the Congolese army claimed to have taken control of Rugezi, Basimukuma grouping, Fizi, on Tuesday 20 May 2025 after night fighting with Twirwaneho allied to AFC-M23; the claim came from Wazalendo spokesperson Aimable Nabulizi, who said the enemy had been dispersed.
r1-SKS-2025Q2-005.a: Wazalendo (Biloze Bishambuke, Gen. Ngomanzito), as claimed
r1-SKS-2025Q2-005.n: Party claim only. Later Radio Okapi (14 Jun) says Rugezi was taken by Twirwaneho/Red Tabara coalition about five days before 14 Jun (see separate claim); control of Rugezi changed hands more than once. No AFC-M23/Twirwaneho account of 20 May found.
r1-SKS-2025Q2-005.vn: Every clause is on the retained page; date and day are in Nabulizi's quote (outside the stored excerpts, so excerpt gap). Kept as a claimed recapture, not as established control. Party claim. The night fighting is also attributed to unnamed 'sources sécuritaires'. Nabulizi said firing was continuing at NAMUROMWA at 12:05. Control of Rugezi changed hands several times (12 April, 9, 19 and 20 May, about 9 June); no Twirwaneho/AFC-M23 account of 20 May found.
src: Les combattants Wazalendo, alliés à l’armée congolaise, revendiquent avoir pris le contrôle de Rugezi, dans le groupement Basimukuma, en territoire de Fizi.
Ces vaillants combattants Wazalendo ont réussi à déloger l’ennemi dans tout Rugezi et ses environs.

r1-SKS-2025Q2-006.s: Radio Okapi reported that recent clashes between the FARDC and a Twirwaneho-Red Tabara-M23 coalition at Rugezi in the hauts et moyens plateaux of Fizi, 'five days ago', caused mass population displacement; the Fizi territory administrator Samy Kalonji Badibanga said some households were heading to Uvira, and unconfirmed information said Wazalendo had singled out displaced people heading to Uvira as belonging to rebel movements.
r1-SKS-2025Q2-006.l: Rugezi, Hauts et Moyens Plateaux de Fizi; route to Uvira
r1-SKS-2025Q2-006.a: FARDC vs Twirwaneho-Red Tabara-M23 coalition; Wazalendo (alleged targeting of displaced)
r1-SKS-2025Q2-006.n: Date computed from 'il y a cinq jours' and publication date 14 Jun (approx. 9 Jun). The singling-out allegation is explicitly unconfirmed. The administrator also said Banyamulenge, Bembe, Fuliru and Barega displaced move together.
r1-SKS-2025Q2-006.vn: All clauses on the retained page; the administrator's name and the Uvira sentence are outside the stored excerpts (excerpt gap). Unconfirmed allegation kept as unconfirmed. Date approximate: 'il y a cinq jours' in an article of 14 June 2025. Lead: the administrator himself refers to information that a group of Banyamulenge displaced people may have been targeted by the Wazalendo ('il y aurait un groupe de déplacés internes Banyamulenge pris pour cible par les Wazalendo'), conditional.
src: Les récents affrontements qui ont opposé les FARDC à la coalition des groupes armés Twirwaneho-Red Tabara-M23 à Rugezi dans les hauts et moyens plateaux du territoire de Fizi il y a cinq jours, ont provoqué un déplacement massif de la population dans la région.

Des informations non confirmées par les sources officielles indiquent que ces déplacés en direction d’Uvira ont été indexés par les Wazalendo comme appartenant aux mouvements rebelles des hauts et moyens plateaux de Fizi.

r1-SKS-2025Q2-007.s: Radio Okapi reported that on Wednesday 11 June the Fizi territory administrator, Samy Kalonji Badibanga, said more than 600 000 internally displaced people lived in precarious conditions in the sectors of Lulenge, Mutambala and Tanganyika, and that their number had grown in the Hauts et Moyens Plateaux of Fizi since the taking of Rugezi village by Twirwaneho and Red Tabara militiamen allied to AFC/M23; he said children no longer attended school, which led to their forced enrolment in armed groups.
r1-SKS-2025Q2-007.l: Lulenge, Mutambala and Tanganyika sectors, Fizi
r1-SKS-2025Q2-007.a: Twirwaneho and Red Tabara allied to AFC/M23 (as named by the administrator)
r1-SKS-2025Q2-007.x: Fizi territory administrator: more than 600,000 displaced
r1-SKS-2025Q2-007.n: Single official source (territory administrator, a Kinshasa-appointed authority); figure not independently verified and exceeds typical OCHA scale for the territory; the administrator is a party-aligned authority. Forced-recruitment statement is his generalisation, no specific incident.
r1-SKS-2025Q2-007.vn: Draft softened the administrator's claim ('risked forced enrolment'); the source says it leads to forced enrolment (a generalisation, no specific incident). Figure written as the source prints it. Figure from one official (a Kinshasa-appointed authority), not independently verified. In source 1, 'Elle' refers to 'cette autorité politico-administrative' (grammatical gender); the stored excerpt_en's 'She' should read 'It (the authority)': the administrator is referred to as 'Il' elsewhere on the page. He also said pregnant women were giving birth in the bush.
src: Plus de 600 000 déplacés internes vivent dans des conditions de précarité dans les secteurs de Lulenge, Mutambala et Tanganyika, a signalé mercredi 11 juin, Samy Kalonji Badibanga, l’administrateur du territoire de Fizi (Sud-Kivu).
Elle a précisé que le nombre de ces déplacés s’est accru dans les Hauts et Moyens Plateaux de Fizi depuis la prise du village de Rugezi par les miliciens Twirwaneho et Red Tabara, alliés à l’AFC/M23.
Les enfants ne fréquentent plus l’école, ce qui entraîne leur enrôlement forcé dans les rangs des groupes armés," a déclaré Samy Kalonji Badibanga.

r1-SKS-2025Q2-008.s: Radio Okapi reported that nearly 4,000 displaced households were registered in the Ruzizi plain, in the cité of Sange and the Kabunambo grouping, caught between FARDC positions to the south and AFC/M23 to the north, having fled Kamanyola, Katogota, Luvungi, Bwegera and Luberizi, hosted since 20 February; Uvira territory administrator Jean de Dieu Masibwa, who visited on Saturday 28 June, called for humanitarian assistance.
r1-SKS-2025Q2-008.l: Sange and Kabunambo; origin Kamanyola, Katogota, Luvungi, Bwegera, Luberizi (Ruzizi plain), Uvira
r1-SKS-2025Q2-008.n: Also a frontline indicator: the page places FARDC south and AFC/M23 north of Sange/Kabunambo at end June.
r1-SKS-2025Q2-008.vn: All clauses on the retained page; Sange/Kabunambo sentence is outside the stored excerpts (excerpt gap). Radio Okapi (UN-backed, non-partisan) own reporting: B. The page also says the displaced lack medicines and latrines, with a risk of waterborne disease. Frontline indicator for end June: FARDC south, AFC/M23 north of Sange/Kabunambo.
src: Près de 4000 ménages de personnes déplacées sont enregistrés dans la plaine de la Ruzizi dans la province du Sud-Kivu. Ces ménages sont coincés entre deux positions belligérantes : les FARDC au sud et l'AFC/ M23 au Nord.

Ces hommes, femmes et enfants ont fui l'insécurité dans leurs milieux d'origine de Kamanyola, Katogota, Luvungi , Bwegera et Luberizi. Ils ont été accueillis à Kabunambo et Sange depuis le 20 février.

L'administrateur du territoire d'Uvira qui les a visités le samedi 28 juin, déplore leurs conditions de vie. Jean de Dieu Masibwa plaide pour une assistance humanitaire pour sauver ces milliers de familles sans abris ni vivres.

r1-SKS-2025Q2-009.s: SOS Médias Burundi reported that intense fighting took place on Saturday 12 April at Rugezi and Kabanju, Fizi territory, between Burundian forces allied to the FARDC and the Mai-Mai Biloze Bishambuke and fighters of the Twirwaneho armed group; according to a Twirwaneho fighter contacted by the outlet, who spoke on condition of anonymity, at least 17 Burundian soldiers were killed and the Twirwaneho captured one of them with radios and rifles.
r1-SKS-2025Q2-009.a: Burundian forces allied to FARDC vs Twirwaneho (and Mai-Mai Biloze Bishambuke as reported)
r1-SKS-2025Q2-009.x: Twirwaneho fighter (anonymous): at least 17 Burundian soldiers killed
r1-SKS-2025Q2-009.n: Single anonymous party source for the toll (Twirwaneho); the outlet's headline says 'Uvira' though the fighting is in Fizi. The Burundian government's account not found. The sentence about Mai-Mai Biloze Bishambuke is ambiguous in the source (it lists them with the Twirwaneho side in one place and with FARDC allies elsewhere).
r1-SKS-2025Q2-009.vn: Draft wrote the clash as Burundians 'with Twirwaneho fighters and Mai-Mai Biloze Bishambuke', which takes a side on an ambiguous sentence; restored the source's wording. Dropped the year (not printed in the excerpts; date field carries it) and the 'dozens over the months' aside (page only, unofficial sources, not about this event). Added the captured-soldier clause, which is in the excerpt. The toll is an anonymous party claim (Twirwaneho), not verified; the outlet's headline and lede state it without the hedge. The source's sentence on the parties is ambiguous: elsewhere it says the Mai-Mai Biloze Bishambuke 'have also suffered losses against the Twirwaneho rebels', i.e. on the FARDC/Burundian side. Lead: one Burundian soldier reported captured (unnamed). No Burundian government account found.
src: According to a Twirwaneho fighter contacted by SOS Médias Burundi, at least 17 Burundian soldiers were killed in the fighting. “Many Burundian soldiers died in the combat. We captured one of them, along with their radios and rifles,” said the fighter, on condition of anonymity.

Intense fighting took place on Saturday, April 12, between Burundian forces allied to the FARDC (Armed Forces of the Democratic Republic of Congo) and the Mai-Mai Biloze Bishambuke and fighters from the Twirwaneho armed group in the towns of Rugezi and Kabanju, Fizi territory, South Kivu province.

r1-SKS-2025Q2-010.s: SOS Médias Burundi reported that since Wednesday new Burundian troops had crossed Lake Tanganyika into the territories of Uvira and Fizi; that on Thursday 22 May several Burundian soldiers stationed at the port of Mboko, in the Tanganyika sector, told residents they were heading to Bijombo to confront the rebels; and that these movements followed a strategic meeting held on 14 May in Uvira between the Congolese and Burundian military high commands.
r1-SKS-2025Q2-010.l: Mboko port, Bijombo, Swima, Uvira and Fizi territories
r1-SKS-2025Q2-010.a: Burundian troops (FDNB) with FARDC and Wazalendo
r1-SKS-2025Q2-010.n: Burundian outlet in exile, anonymous local sources; Burundi government has not confirmed. The same article places earlier clashes at Kahololo (Uvira) the previous week and at Rugezi (Fizi) between Burundian forces, Wazalendo, FARDC and Twirwaneho (not used as a claim: no excerpt on detail). The 14 May meeting is attributed to security sources.
r1-SKS-2025Q2-010.vn: Removed the publication date and 'citing local sources' (the page states the troop crossing in its own voice; 'local sources' are cited for the earlier clashes). Meeting is the outlet's narration; 'security sources' are cited only for what it marked. Burundian outlet in exile; anonymous local and security sources; Burundi has not confirmed. The page also reports Burundian units seen in Swima en route to Gihamba and Kajembwe (Bijombo groupement), and 'approximately 10,000 Burundian soldiers' 'reportedly' engaged in the DRC.
src: Since Wednesday, new Burundian troops have crossed Lake Tanganyika into the territories of Uvira and Fizi, in South Kivu province.

On Thursday, May 22, several Burundian soldiers stationed at the port of Mboko, in the Tanganyika sector, informed residents that they were heading to Bijombo, a strategic area in the highlands, to confront the rebels.
strategic meeting held on May 14 in Uvira between the Congolese and Burundian military high commands.

r1-SKS-2025Q2-011.s: SOS Médias Burundi reported on 4 June 2025, citing several local and humanitarian sources, that more than 3,000 people in the Burundian refugee camps of Mulongwe and Lusenda in Fizi territory had reportedly joined Wazalendo militias; a refugee quoted said he earned up to 10,000 Congolese francs a day at a Wazalendo checkpoint in Baraka, and refugees said some returned to the camps armed and in uniform.
r1-SKS-2025Q2-011.l: Mulongwe and Lusenda refugee camps; Baraka, Fizi
r1-SKS-2025Q2-011.x: SOS Médias Burundi: more than 3,000 refugees reportedly joined Wazalendo
r1-SKS-2025Q2-011.n: Figure 'plus de 3 000' is an unverified estimate ('auraient'); NGOs on site said it was plausible. The page says UNHCR withdrew from Lusenda and Mulongwe in January and that CNR Baraka reminded that refugees may not join armed groups. Voluntary enrolment as described, not forced.
r1-SKS-2025Q2-011.vn: All clauses on the retained page (dateline, quote and camp passage outside the stored excerpts: excerpt gap). Hedge kept. 'auraient intégré' = reportedly joined: an unverified estimate; NGOs on site called it plausible. Enrolment as described is voluntary (pay, end of food aid), not forced. UNHCR withdrew from the two camps in January per the page. 2026-10-28: source 0 sources.append edited: fact-check fc1: SOS Médias Burundi, Bukavu 4 June 2025: per several local and humanitarian sources, more than 3,000 people in Mulongwe and Lusenda camps (Fizi) reportedly (auraient) joined Wazalendo. All clauses are on the page; the stored excerpts lacked the 10,000 FC checkpoint quote and the 'several refugees say' passage, now added. 2026-10-28: source 1 sources.append edited: fact-check fc1: SOS Médias Burundi, Bukavu 4 June 2025: per several local and humanitarian sources, more than 3,000 people in Mulongwe and Lusenda camps (Fizi) reportedly (auraient) joined Wazalendo. All clauses are on the page; the stored excerpts lacked the 10,000 FC checkpoint quote and the 'several refugees say' passage, now added.
src: plus de 3 000 personnes auraient intégré les milices Wazalendo, des groupes armés locaux soutenus par les autorités congolaises dans le conflit qui secoue la région. L’information est rapportée par plusieurs sources locales et humanitaires contactées par SOS Médias Burundi.
Ils arrivent désormais en uniforme et armés, alors qu’ils sont encore enregistrés comme réfugiés », confie une réfugiée burundaise mariée à un milicien.
Quand je travaille à un poste de contrôle des Wazalendo à Baraka, je peux gagner jusqu’à 10 000 francs congolais par jour.

Plusieurs réfugiés affirment que certains de leurs compagnons rentrent armés et en tenue militaire, malgré leur statut officiel de réfugié, faisant craindre des représailles d’autres groupes armés ou des FARDC (Forces armées de la RDC).

r1-SKS-2025Q2-012.s: Kivu Morning Post reported that Congolese army drones reportedly bombed on Thursday 15 May 2025 the positions of Twirwaneho fighters allied to AFC-M23 at NDAKE/Mikenge, Itombwe sector, Basimukindji 1 grouping, Mwenga; an anonymous security source claimed dozens of officers were eliminated, a figure the page does not corroborate.
r1-SKS-2025Q2-012.x: Anonymous security source: dozens of officers killed (unverified)
r1-SKS-2025Q2-012.n: Anonymous security source; casualty claim unverified. Conditional ('auraient bombardé'). Mikenge is in Mwenga territory (Itombwe) per the page.
r1-SKS-2025Q2-012.vn: All clauses on the retained page; location sentence outside the stored excerpts (excerpt gap). Conditional ('auraient bombardé'). The toll is an anonymous, pro-government security source's claim (it calls the Twirwaneho a 'mouvement terroriste') and is unverified. 'NDAKE' is described by that source as the name commonly given to the camps/positions at Mikenge. 2026-10-29: source 0 excerpt_en edited: QA 0.4 A3: non-English excerpt shown without an English translation; translation added, marked as one 2026-10-29: source 1 excerpt_en edited: QA 0.4 A3: non-English excerpt shown without an English translation; translation added, marked as one
src: Des drones de l’armée congolaise auraient bombardé hier, jeudi 15 mai 2025, les positions des combattants Twirwaneho alliés à l’Alliance du Fleuve Congo M23 à NDAKE/Mikenge.
On compte aujourd’hui des dizaines d’officiers AFC Twirwaneho M23 éliminés à Mikenge par ce drone,” a déclaré une source sécuritaire sous couvert d’anonymat à Kivumorningpost .

r1-SKS-2025Q2-013.s: Kivutimes reported on 1 May 2025 that the Hôpital général de référence d'Itombwe at Mikenge, in the Hauts-Plateaux of Mwenga territory, was the victim of systematic looting of its medical equipment during violent clashes between the Twirwaneho armed group, allied to AFC/M23, and Wazalendo groups in March 2025; Nakiele hospital centre donated a binocular microscope and caesarean, delivery and hernia kits.
r1-SKS-2025Q2-013.l: Hôpital général de référence d'Itombwe, Mikenge, Itombwe sector, Mwenga
r1-SKS-2025Q2-013.a: Not attributed by the source for the looting (clashes between Twirwaneho/AFC-M23 and Wazalendo)
r1-SKS-2025Q2-013.n: Local outlet (Kivutimes, Bukavu/Uvira). Looting happened in March (before the unit window); recorded because the report and the relocation measure fall on 1 May. Perpetrator not named. Second excerpt = relocation authorised by health authorities.
r1-SKS-2025Q2-013.vn: Every clause on the retained page; donation and byline date outside the stored excerpts (excerpt gap). In the investigation window although before this unit's quarter; dated as the source dates it. Looting dated by the source only to March 2025 (month precision), during clashes; the source does not say who looted. The page spells the group 'twigwaneho'. Health authorities authorised temporary relocation of the hospital to Kipupu or Kiseke because Mikenge had become unliveable. Named on the page: Dr Sumaili Enas Prince (Nakiele) and the Itombwe hospital accountant Ebulaca Ngulumina (received the equipment on Friday 1 May). 2026-10-29: source 0 excerpt_en edited: QA 0.4 A3: non-English excerpt shown without an English translation; translation added, marked as one 2026-10-29: source 1 excerpt_en edited: QA 0.4 A3: non-English excerpt shown without an English translation; translation added, marked as one
src: a été victime d’un pillage systématique de ses équipements médicaux lors des violents affrontements qui ont opposé le groupe armé twigwaneho allié à l’AFC/M23 aux groupes de wazalendo au mois de mars 2025 dans cette zone.
Mikenge est devenu invivable suite à la situation sécuritaire, les autorités sanitaires autorisent la relocalisation temporaire de cet établissement sanitaire soit à Kipupu ou à Kiseke

r1-SKS-2025Q2-014.s: Radio Okapi reported that AFC/M23 rebels took the chefferie of Luhwinja, Mwenga territory, without fighting on the evening of Tuesday 6 May 2025, and that the groupements of Luchiga, Kabalole, Luduha and Idudwe also passed under rebel control from 6 May; according to local sources Luhwinja was the first entity of Mwenga to fall under rebel occupation since the fall of Bukavu.
r1-SKS-2025Q2-014.l: Luhwinja chefferie; Luchiga, Kabalole, Luduha, Idudwe groupements; Mwenga
r1-SKS-2025Q2-014.n: Walungu/Mwenga highlands, adjacent to this unit; may duplicate a Mwenga/Walungu unit claim. Radio Okapi, 'selon des sources locales'. AFC/M23 and Kinshasa accounts not found in this round.
r1-SKS-2025Q2-014.vn: All clauses on the retained page. Radio Okapi own reporting: B. No AFC/M23 or Kinshasa statement found. Possible overlap with a Mwenga/Walungu unit; no verified claim on this event was found in the store at verification time, so not marked duplicate. 2026-10-29: source 0 excerpt_en edited: QA 0.4 A3: non-English excerpt shown without an English translation; translation added, marked as one 2026-10-29: source 1 excerpt_en edited: QA 0.4 A3: non-English excerpt shown without an English translation; translation added, marked as one
src: Les rebelles de la coalition AFC/M23 se sont emparés, sans combattre, de la chefferie de Luhwinja, dans le territoire de Mwenga au Sud-Kivu, dans la soirée du mardi 6 mai.
Par ailleurs, depuis mardi 6 mai, les groupements de Luchiga, Kabalole, Luduha et Idudwe sont également passés sous contrôle rebelle.

r1-SKS-2025Q2-015.s: Radio Okapi reported on 29 April 2025, citing local sources, that AFC/M23 rebels who had come from Nyangezi via Mushenyi were attacking FARDC and Wazalendo positions in the Kaziba chefferie (Walungu), and that from Kaziba the rebels were progressing toward Minembwe in the Hauts Plateaux of Fizi while another group advanced toward Luhwinja.
r1-SKS-2025Q2-015.l: Kaziba (Walungu) toward Minembwe (Hauts Plateaux de Fizi) and Luhwinja (Mwenga)
r1-SKS-2025Q2-015.n: Kaziba is in Walungu; recorded here only for the stated advance toward Minembwe. The 27 April Radio Okapi piece (Kaziba assault from 26 April) states AFC-M23 aims to reach Twirwaneho allies in the Minembwe plateaux; not separately cited.
r1-SKS-2025Q2-015.vn: All clauses on the retained page; the Nyangezi/Mushenyi sentence is outside the stored excerpts (excerpt gap). Not a duplicate of any verified claim. Kaziba is in Walungu. The page also reports testimonies of indiscriminate shelling of inhabited areas with significant material and human damage, toll not available (lead). Possible overlap with a Walungu unit; no verified claim on this event found in the store. 2026-10-29: source 0 excerpt_en edited: QA 0.4 A3: non-English excerpt shown without an English translation; translation added, marked as one 2026-10-29: source 1 excerpt_en edited: QA 0.4 A3: non-English excerpt shown without an English translation; translation added, marked as one
src: Depuis Kaziba, les rebelles progressent vers Minembwe, dans les Hauts Plateaux de Fizi, tandis qu’un autre groupe avance vers Luhwinja, siège de la société aurifère Twangiza Mining.
Selon des sources locales, de fortes détonations d’armes lourdes et légères retentissent depuis le matin dans toute la chefferie de Kaziba, territoire de Walungu.

r1-SKS-2025Q3-001.s: Kivu Morning Post reported clashes between Wazalendo fighters allied to the Congolese army and AFC-M23 rebels allied to Twirwaneho; according to security sources, the fighting was taking place in several villages of Balala Nord groupement, Fizi territory, and the same sources said it was a Wazalendo offensive.
r1-SKS-2025Q3-001.a: Wazalendo (allied to the army) vs AFC-M23 / Twirwaneho
r1-SKS-2025Q3-001.n: Kivu Morning Post (Goma/Bukavu-based local outlet). No casualty figures. Excerpt translation is of the quoted passage only.
r1-SKS-2025Q3-001.vn: Page supports the clauses; the day is not in the stored excerpt, so it stays in the date field (page: 'depuis ce matin, mercredi 02 juillet 2025').
src: Ces combats opposent les combattants Wazalendo, alliés à l’armée congolaise, aux rebelles de l’AFC-M23, alliés aux Twirwaneho. Selon des sources sécuritaires, ces combats se déroulent dans plusieurs villages du groupement de Balala Nord, en territoire de Fizi. Les mêmes sources ajoutent qu’il s’agit d’une offensive des Wazalendo.

r1-SKS-2025Q3-002.s: A Wazalendo spokesperson told Kivu Morning Post that Wazalendo of the FDCC, led by General Kakobanya, attacked AFC Twirwaneho M23 strongholds at Bijabo, Namara and Kamombo in Balala Nord groupement, Fizi territory, from Tuesday 1 July 2025.
r1-SKS-2025Q3-002.l: Bijabo, Namara, Kamombo (Balala Nord groupement), Fizi
r1-SKS-2025Q3-002.a: Wazalendo FDCC under General Kakobanya (own account)
r1-SKS-2025Q3-002.n: Quote attributed on the page to a Wazalendo spokesperson (partisan, party account of its own operation). The page's own attribution follows the quoted text.
r1-SKS-2025Q3-002.vn: Excerpt and attribution verified on page; spokesperson unnamed on the page. Party account of its own operation. The same article quotes an anonymous Wazalendo security source saying the FDCC sacked AFC Twirwaneho M23 camps at Bichumbe (Itombwe sector, Mwenga) on the morning of 2 July.
src: Depuis hier, mardi 01 juillet 2025, les Wazalendo du FDCC, dirigé par le Général KAKOBANYA, ont attaqué les fiefs de l’AFC Twirwaneho M23 à BIJABO, NAMARA et KAMOMBO, en groupement de Balala Nord, secteur de Tanganyika, territoire de Fizi.

r1-SKS-2025Q3-003.s: Kivu Times reported, citing local sources, that fighting broke out on 25 July 2025 between Wazalendo of Bilozebishambuke, led by Delphin Ngomanzito, and Twigwaneho/M23 elements in several localities of Bashimunyaka Sud groupement, Lulenge sector, Fizi territory (Natulonge, Luhemba, Kawela and chez Sekaganda). It said no human or material toll was yet known and that no security or administrative authority had yet communicated.
r1-SKS-2025Q3-003.l: Natulonge, Luhemba, Kawela, chez Sekaganda (Bashimunyaka Sud groupement, Lulenge sector), Fizi
r1-SKS-2025Q3-003.n: Local outlet (Kivu Times, South Kivu). Spelling 'Twigwaneho' as printed. Villages named in the article body (Natulonge, Luhemba, Kawela, chez Sekaganda); toll unknown at time of writing.
r1-SKS-2025Q3-003.vn: All clauses on page; villages, toll and no-statement clauses sit in the body (excerpt gap only).
src: Fizi, 25 juillet 2025: Des violents combats ont éclaté ce matin entre les groupes Wazalendo de Bilozebishambuke, dirigés par Delphin Ngomanzito, et les éléments du groupe Twigwaneho/M23, dans plusieurs localités du groupement de Bashimunyaka Sud, situé dans le secteur de Lulenge, hauts-plateaux du territoire de Fizi, dans la province du Sud-Kivu.

r1-SKS-2025Q3-004.s: SOS Médias Burundi reported on 6 August 2025 that violent fighting had opposed, since Wednesday, Wazalendo and the Twirwaneho group in Itombwe sector, Mwenga territory, concentrated around Mikenge, Marunde and Bukunji, where the Wazalendo, backed by the FDLR according to the outlet, launched a coordinated offensive against Twirwaneho positions. The outlet reported that no official toll had been communicated.
r1-SKS-2025Q3-004.n: Date: 'Wednesday' in a dispatch dated 6 Aug 2025 (Wednesday = 6 Aug; date computed from weekday and publication date). FDLR support is the outlet's assertion; the Wazalendo spokesperson did not acknowledge it (see next claim). SOS Médias Burundi is a Burundian exile-run outlet.
r1-SKS-2025Q3-004.vn: Dateline supplies the date; FDLR wording kept as the outlet's. FDLR support is SOS Médias Burundi's own assertion; the same article also asserts, without a source, that the FDNB deployed at least 10.000 soldiers alongside FARDC and Wazalendo. The Wazalendo spokesperson did not acknowledge FDLR support (see related claim).
src: Les combats de ce mercredi se sont concentrés autour des localités de Mikenge, Marunde et Bukunji, où les Wazalendo, appuyés par les Forces démocratiques de libération du Rwanda (FDLR), ont lancé une offensive coordonnée contre les positions tenues par Twirwaneho.

r1-SKS-2025Q3-005.s: SOS Médias Burundi reported that, in a communiqué sent to it, Aimable Nabulizi, spokesperson of the Wazalendo in South Kivu, accused Twirwaneho fighters of having attacked their positions, without acknowledging the support attributed to the FDLR or the Burundian and Congolese armies.
r1-SKS-2025Q3-005.n: Wazalendo account; the 'support' wording is the outlet's.
r1-SKS-2025Q3-005.vn: Excerpt verbatim on page; single clause; party statement. The 'appui reçu' framing is the outlet's.
src: Dans un communiqué transmis à SOS Médias Burundi, Aimable Nabulizi, porte-parole des Wazalendo dans le Sud-Kivu, a accusé les combattants Twirwaneho d’avoir attaqué leurs positions, sans toutefois reconnaître l’appui reçu de la part des FDLR ni des armées burundaise et congolaise.

r1-SKS-2025Q3-006.s: Kivu Morning Post reported that in a communiqué published on 6 August the MRDP-Twirwaneho denounced attacks by the FARDC, with the support of the FDLR and the Burundian army, targeting the villages of Kipupu, Bilalo Mbili and Lulenge in the Minembwe region, and said these offensives specifically targeted Banyamulenge civilians. The communiqué said several villages, including in the Mikenge locality, had been hit by heavy-weapon attacks causing many deaths and forcing hundreds of families to flee again, and that the victims were deprived of all emergency aid.
r1-SKS-2025Q3-006.l: Kipupu, Bilalo Mbili, Lulenge (Minembwe region), Fizi/Mwenga
r1-SKS-2025Q3-006.a: MRDP-Twirwaneho (speaker); alleged perpetrators FARDC, FDLR, Burundian army
r1-SKS-2025Q3-006.n: Party allegation (Twirwaneho), cited only for what it said. Article dated 7 Aug refers to 'hier, le 6 août'.
r1-SKS-2025Q3-006.vn: Year removed (page prints only 'le 6 août'); added the communiqué's own casualty/aid-deprivation allegation, attributed; the localities Malunde and Kivogerwa are printed on the page but not in the stored excerpt, so only Mikenge (in the title) is named. Party allegation (Twirwaneho); no casualty count or independent confirmation. 2026-10-28: source 0 sources.append edited: fact-check fc1: Kivu Morning Post (7 Aug 2025) carries all clauses as the MRDP-Twirwaneho's account; the stored excerpt covers only the first sentence, so the heavy-weapon/deaths passage is added. Localities named are Malunde, Mikenge and Kivogerwa.
src: Dans un communiqué publié hier, le 6 août, le MRDP-Twirwaneho a dénoncé les attaques orchestrées par les FARDC, avec le soutien des FDLR et de l’armée burundaise, ciblant les villages de Kipupu, Bilalo Mbili et Lulenge, dans la région de Minembwe.

« Plusieurs villages des localités de Malunde, Mikenge et Kivogerwa ont été la cible d’attaques à l’arme lourde, causant de nombreux morts et forçant des centaines de familles, déjà en pleine réinstallation, à fuir à nouveau leurs foyers », déplore le communiqué.

r1-SKS-2025Q3-007.s: Kivu Morning Post reported that fighting broke out that morning at Mikenge between Wazalendo of the FDCC, led by General Kakobanya and allied to the Congolese army, and Twirwaneho forces allied to AFC-M23; according to local sources heavy and light weapon fire was heard. The outlet said the Wazalendo had claimed the capture of Mikenge the day before and that the morning attack was seen as a Twirwaneho counter-offensive.
r1-SKS-2025Q3-007.n: Territory (Mwenga) is from the SOS Médias Burundi report on Mikenge, not from this excerpt; confirm at verification.
r1-SKS-2025Q3-007.vn: The '7 August' day is not printed in the article text; narrowed to 'that morning'. Added the outlet's frontline note on the Wazalendo capture claim (contiguous page passage). The article is dated 7 August 2025 and says 'ce matin'; the date is the publication date. Territory (Mwenga) is not stated in this article.
src: Ce matin, des combats ont éclaté à Mikenge entre les Wazalendo du FDCC, dirigés par le Général Kakobanya, alliés à l’armée congolaise, et les forces Twirwaneho alliées à l’AFC-M23. Selon des sources locales de KivuMorningPost, des tirs nourris d’armes lourdes et légères ont été entendus dans la zone.

r1-SKS-2025Q3-008.s: Actualite.cd reported that two police officers were killed at Maheta village, Mwenga territory, after a clash with elements of the Twirwaneho, Ngumino and Red Tabara coalition, according to civil society sources. Kelvin Bwija, coordinator of Congolese civil society for the Uvira - Fizi axis, named among the victims the commander of the Itombwe commissariat, Kapinga Lwesso, and a police officer, Kabambi Lulenda, and said several other bodies had not yet been found; another source said one more person had been carried away into the bush.
r1-SKS-2025Q3-008.l: Maheta, between Maheta and Mikungubwe (Itombwe sector, Basilukidji 1), Mwenga
r1-SKS-2025Q3-008.a: Twirwaneho, Ngumino, Red Tabara coalition (per civil society sources)
r1-SKS-2025Q3-008.n: Single local report citing civil society. The body states 'deux éléments de la police ont été tués ... samedi 23 août' (date stated in text). Status of 'victims' as police killed; the quote also says other bodies not found. Quote opens with 'Parmi ces victimes'; the Actualite.cd page uses straight quotes.
r1-SKS-2025Q3-008.vn: Year not printed in body (dateline 24/08/2025 only) so removed; 'sub-commissariat' corrected to 'commissariat' as Bwija says; 'another officer' narrowed to 'one more person' (page: 'un autre'); Birimba/Mikungubwe place detail and the date kept out of the statement because the stored excerpt does not print them (see clause_support and note); date field holds 23 August. Original: place detail added from the same passage. The page spells the coalition 'Twirwaheno' in its first sentence and 'Twirwaneho' later; it also lists 'Android' and M23/AFC allies in the coalition. Status of the person carried into the bush is not stated.
src: Parmi ces victimes nous avons le commandant du commissariat d'Itombwe connu sous le nom de Kapinga Lwesso, un policier connu sous le nom de Kabambi Lulenda et plusieurs autres corps ne sont pas jusqu'à présent retrouvent", a dit Kelvin Bwija, coordonnateur de la société civile Congolaise axe Uvira - Fizi.

r1-SKS-2025Q3-009.s: Radio Okapi reported that FARDC, supported by Wazalendo militias, and a rebel coalition of Twirwaneho, Red Tabara and M23/AFC had been fighting since Tuesday 26 August in the high and middle plateaux of Fizi territory, concentrated in Mutambala sector around Rugezi village in Basimukuma-Sud groupement; Fizi territory administrator Samy Kalonji Badibanga said the rebels sought to seize the Misisi and Salamabila mining sites.
r1-SKS-2025Q3-009.a: FARDC and Wazalendo vs Twirwaneho, Red Tabara, M23/AFC
r1-SKS-2025Q3-009.n: Radio Okapi; administrator is a Kinshasa-appointed official (party account on motive). Start date 'depuis le mardi 26 août' is in the page.
r1-SKS-2025Q3-009.vn: All clauses on page; page passage (replacement_quotes) documents the dated lead sentence. Start date differs between outlets: Radio Okapi 'depuis le mardi 26 août'; SOS Médias Burundi and Kivu Morning Post give Wednesday 27 August. Motive is the Kinshasa-appointed administrator's account.
src: Selon Samy Kalonji Badibanga, administrateur du territoire, les rebelles cherchent à s’emparer de sites miniers stratégiques, notamment ceux de Misisi et Salamabila, riches en or et coltan.
Les affrontements sont concentrés dans le secteur de Mutambala, notamment autour du village de Rugezi, dans le groupement de Basimukuma-Sud.

r1-SKS-2025Q3-010.s: SOS Médias Burundi reported on 28 August 2025 that fighting between the FARDC, backed by Wazalendo militias kept up by Kinshasa and the Burundian army (in the outlet's words), and the Twirwaneho and M23 groups began on Wednesday 27 August in Rugezi (Fizi), Mwite and Kangovu (Mwenga), then spread on Thursday to Mikenge and Bilalo Mbili. It quoted a resident saying there were no more medicines at Minembwe.
r1-SKS-2025Q3-010.l: Rugezi (Fizi); Mwite, Kangovu, Mikenge, Bilalo Mbili (Mwenga/Minembwe)
r1-SKS-2025Q3-010.a: FARDC, Wazalendo (outlet: with Burundian army) vs Twirwaneho and M23
r1-SKS-2025Q3-010.n: Date of start differs from Radio Okapi (26 Aug) and Kivu Morning Post (27 Aug at Rugezi); discrepancy to surface. Dispatch is dated 28 Aug; page dated 29 Aug in search results. Resident statement on lack of medicines is an unnamed testimony (health access context).
r1-SKS-2025Q3-010.vn: Dateline gives 28 August 2025; claims verified on page. Start date 27 August here vs 26 August in Radio Okapi; both kept. Burundian army participation is the outlet's assertion. The resident's statement on medicines is unnamed testimony.
src: Les hostilités ont débuté mercredi 27 août dans les zones de Rugezi (Fizi), Mwite et Kangovu (Mwenga), avant de s’étendre ce jeudi à Mikenge et Bilalo Mbili.

« Il n’y a plus de médicaments à Minembwe, plus de marché, ni d’écoles. Nos enfants vivent dans la peur constante à cause de ces guerres déclenchées par les Wazalendo et les FARDC », témoigne un résident

r1-SKS-2025Q3-011.s: Kivu Morning Post reported that fighting broke out on 27 August 2025 at Rugezi (Mutambala sector, Fizi) between AFC-M23 rebels allied to Twirwaneho and Wazalendo backed by the FARDC. It said the Wazalendo units were led by Lt General Delphin Kalembe Ngomanzito of the Force d'auto-défense Wazalendo Biloze Bishambuke (FABB), who said he had repelled attacks by AFC-M23 and Red Tabara at Rugezi.
r1-SKS-2025Q3-011.a: Wazalendo FABB (Lt Gen Delphin Kalembe Ngomanzito) vs AFC-M23 / Twirwaneho / Red Tabara
r1-SKS-2025Q3-011.n: Wazalendo claim of repelling attack is the commander's own account. Same page says a day earlier clashes between army and Wazalendo were reported in Uvira town (outside this unit).
r1-SKS-2025Q3-011.vn: Verified on page; page passage (replacement_quotes) documents the dated lead.
src: Les unités Wazalendo sont dirigées par le Lt Général Delphin Kalembe Ngomanzito de la Force d’auto-défense Wazalendo Biloze Bishambuke (FABB), qui affirme avoir repoussé les attaques menées par l’AFC-M23 et Red Tabara à Rugezi, secteur de Mutambala.

r1-SKS-2025Q3-012.s: Radio Okapi reported that fighting broke out on the morning of Thursday 18 September 2025 between two Wazalendo factions in Mwenga territory, linked to a provincial decision to remove illegal barriers, notably those of the self-proclaimed general Yakaliba; according to local sources, fighters loyal to 'general' Malaika, backed by former provincial interior minister Foka Mike and the FARDC, dismantled checkpoints on Route nationale 2. A provisional toll of several dead and wounded was given.
r1-SKS-2025Q3-012.a: Wazalendo factions (Yakaliba vs Malaika) with FARDC
r1-SKS-2025Q3-012.n: A KMP report of 19 Sep (already cited in the project) gives a toll of 8 dead and 5 wounded; not re-cited. Radio Okapi gives 'plusieurs morts et blessés'.
r1-SKS-2025Q3-012.vn: Verified on page; page passages (replacement_quotes) document the dated lead and the toll sentence. Exchanges of fire reported at Mwenga-Centre per the page. Radio Okapi gives no exact toll.
src: Selon plusieurs sources locales, ces affrontements sont liés à la décision des autorités provinciales de supprimer les barrières illégales érigées dans la région, notamment par les hommes du général autoproclamé Yakaliba.

les combattants fidèles au « général » Malaika, soutenus par l’ancien ministre provincial de l’Intérieur, Foka Mike, et les Forces armées de la RDC (FARDC), ont démantelé ces points de contrôle sur la Route nationale 2.

r1-SKS-2025Q3-013.s: Actualite.cd reported that a man and his wife were killed in the night of 28 to 29 September 2025 in Baraka town, South Kivu; local civil society said they were shot at home by armed men 'not otherwise identified'.
r1-SKS-2025Q3-013.a: not attributed by the source (armed men)
r1-SKS-2025Q3-013.n: Victims not named. Source: Martin Fikiri, coordinator of Nouvelle société civile congolaise axe Uvira-Fizi (named elsewhere in the page).
r1-SKS-2025Q3-013.vn: Verified on page. Victims not named. Actualite.cd's headline calls the perpetrators 'bandits armés'; the civil society coordinator Martin Fikiri said 'hommes armés non autrement identifiés'.

The Fizi territory administrator, Sammy Badibanga, warned of a grave humanitarian crisis, denounced the persistent illicit exploitation of natural resources, and called for an urgent strengthening of emergency interventions by provincial and national authorities and NGOs.

L’administrateur territorial de Fizi, Sammy Badibanga, alerte sur une grave crise humanitaire liée aux violences causées par ces miliciens dans la région du Sud-Kivu. Ces groupes armés, qualifiés de « hors-la-loi », exploitent illégalement des minerais d’or et de coltan dans la chaîne de Mitumba, contribuant ainsi fortement à l’insécurité persistante.

mais appelle à un renforcement urgent des interventions d’urgence des autorités provinciales, nationales et des ONG, afin d’atténuer les souffrances de la population et stopper l’exploitation illégale des minerais.

r1-SKS-2025Q3-016.s: Radio Okapi reported that on 16 July 2025 the Fizi territory administrator, Samy Kalonji Badibanga, said the humanitarian situation of displaced people from the high and middle plateaux of Fizi was critical, deprived of food, drinking water, medical care and shelter.

Ces déplacés, indique-t-il, viennent des hauts et moyens plateaux aux alentours de Minembwe ainsi que du village de Rugezi. "Le territoire de Fizi compte à ce jour plus de 600.000 déplacés internes. src: Au moins 05 cas de viols et plusieurs actes d’extorsions et coups et blessures, enlèvements leur auraient été allégués en début de période.
La situation de protection demeure affectée par l’activisme de divers groupes armés perpétrant des actes d’extorsions et autres violations des droits humains, notamment dans le secteur d’Itombwe.
Ces violations de droits de l’homme se déroulent dans un contexte de recul des forces gouvernementales et d’extension de l’emprise des groupes armés sur les localités du territoire.

r1-SKS-2025Q3-018.s: The DRC Protection Cluster July 2025 highlights reported, for Fizi territory, abductions of civilians, extortion and rape of women by armed groups, in a context where security forces seemed to be gradually losing control of some localities, and that on 19 July 13 civilians were reportedly taken hostage in the bush of villages in Babungwe-Nord groupement.
r1-SKS-2025Q3-018.n: Aggregate monitoring; no counts of rape cases for Fizi in the passage. The document heading has a typo ('Kasaï') over the Fizi section; the passage sits under South Kivu territories (Fizi follows Uvira).
r1-SKS-2025Q3-018.vn: Both passages verified in the PDF under 'Territoire de Fizi'. Aggregate monitoring; no count of rape cases for Fizi; hostage-taking is reported in the conditional.
src: Elle se manifeste notamment par des actes d’enlèvement de civils, d’extorsions des biens et de viols des femmes dans un contexte où les forces de sécurité et de défense semblent perdre progressivement le contrôle de certaines localités.
Le 19 juillet, 13 civils auraient été pris en otage par les éléments d’un groupe armé dans la brousse des villages du groupement de Babungwe-Nord.

r1-SKS-2025Q3-019.s: The DRC Protection Cluster July 2025 highlights reported that on 23 July several gunshots were heard in Kagurube/Runingu village on the RN512 north of Uvira, and that, fearing clashes, about 202 households (1,010 people) of Runingu reportedly moved preventively to Sange, Mwaba, Biriba, Kabunambo and Kiliba.
r1-SKS-2025Q3-019.l: Kagurube/Runingu (RN512, north of Uvira) to Sange, Mwaba, Biriba, Kabunambo, Kiliba
src: Le 23 juillet, plusieurs coups de feu ont été entendus dans le village de Kagurube/Runingu, situé sur la RN512 au Nord d’Uvira. Craignant les affrontements, environ 202 ménages de 1,010 personnes de Runingu se seraient déplacés préventivement vers le village de Sange, Mwaba, Biriba, Kabunambo et Kiliba.

r1-SKS-2025Q3-020.s: Actualite.cd reported that in a communiqué of 12 August 2025 signed by FARDC spokesperson Major General Sylvain Ekenge, the FARDC denounced what they called an intentional and manifest violation of the Washington peace agreement and the Doha declaration of principles by the AFC/M23, citing near-daily attacks on their positions in North and South Kivu, and reserved the right to respond appropriately to provocations.
r1-SKS-2025Q3-020.n: General statement, not specific to this unit's geography; cited for what the FARDC said. Page is also the source of the AFC/M23 counter-statement below.
r1-SKS-2025Q3-020.vn: Verified on page; page passage (replacement_quotes) documents the date. Party statement. The same communiqué, as reported, also alleged targeted massacres of mostly Hutu civilians in North Kivu by the AFC/M23 coalition.
src: les FARDC réservent le droit de répondre de manière appropriée à toutes les provocations de cette coalition habituée à violer les accords et la parole donnée ", dit le communiqué signé par le Général-Major Sylvain Ekenge, porte-parole des FARDC.

r1-SKS-2025Q3-021.s: Actualite.cd reported that the AFC/M23 alerted to major FARDC troop and equipment movements at Nzimbira, Mwenga, Bunyakiri, Kibuwa, Pinga and Uvira, and said two military ships carrying 1,125 fighters of the Kinshasa-regime coalition forces docked on Kalemie-Uvira axis on Sunday 10 August 2025.
r1-SKS-2025Q3-021.n: AFC/M23 allegation relayed by Actualite.cd; cited only for what AFC/M23 said. Uvira port is Uvira city (outside this unit); included because of the territory-wide troop-movement claim. No independent confirmation.

src: Kalemie- Uvira (où deux navires militaires transportant 1 125 combattants des forces coalisées du régime de Kinshasa ont accosté dimanche 10 août 2025).

r1-SKS-2025Q3-022.s: Radio Okapi reported that on Saturday 6 September the FARDC presented to the press six people arrested on the high plateaux of Fizi and Uvira, whom the army accused of collaborating with the AFC/M23. As presented by the FARDC, they included a man identified as Nuyomugabo Sagel, described as a serving soldier of the Rwanda Defence Forces; FARDC spokesperson Major General Sylvain Ekenge said the arrest was tangible proof of Rwanda's direct involvement in the conflict. The army described the others as Byishimuse Dieudonné, a Rwandan national trained for the M23; Biringiro Bironi Tesane and Sadiki Elisa, AFC/M23 fighters; Ngaianga Ramazani, affiliated with Twirwaneho; and Muhingirrwa Sangwa Vincent, a state agent and alleged M23 collaborator arrested in Uvira but living in Bujumbura. All were transferred to Kinshasa for interrogation. The identities and affiliations are as presented by the FARDC.

src: Les autres suspects incluent : Byishimuse Dieudonné, ressortissant rwandais formé pour le M23, Biringiro Bironi Tesane et Sadiki Elisa, combattants de l’AFC/M23, Ngaianga Ramazani, affilié au groupe Twirwaneho, Muhingirrwa Sangwa Vincent, agent de l’État et collaborateur présumé du M23, arrêté à Uvira mais résidant à Bujumbura.
Selon le général-major Sylvain Ekenge, porte-parole des FARDC, cette arrestation constitue une preuve tangible de l’implication directe du Rwanda dans le conflit à l’Est du pays.
Parmi eux figure un militaire rwandais en activité, identifié comme Nuyomugabo Sagel, membre des Forces de défense du Rwanda.

Les Forces armées de la République démocratique du Congo (FARDC) ont présenté, ce samedi 6 septembre, à la presse six individus interpellés dans les Hauts plateaux de Fizi et d’Uvira, accusés de collaboration avec les rebelles de l’AFC/M23.
Tous ont été transférés à Kinshasa pour interrogatoire approfondi.

r1-SKS-2025Q3-023.n: Partisan allegation with no dates, places or victims; cited only as what Wazalendo said. Responds to the UN Group of Experts' finding of FARDC/Wazalendo cooperation with the FDLR (per the page).

Communiqué spokesperson: Aimable Nabulizi. 2026-10-28: source 0 sources.append edited: fact-check fc1: Kivu Morning Post (10 Jul 2025) reports the communiqué of the Coordination Politique des Volontaires/Wazalendo pour la Défense de la Patrie au Sud-Kivu; the stored excerpt carries the accusations but not the FDLR denial, added here. The same page notes that a recent UN report says the army and Wazalendo collaborate closely with the FDLR.
src: Les Wazalendo accusent également les Twirwaneho d’utiliser les populations civiles comme boucliers humains et de commettre des violences graves dans les zones sous leur influence. Ils évoquent notamment des cas de viols, d’incendies, de destruction de biens et d’occupation illégale de terres.
« Les FARDC et les Wazalendo ne sont pas des criminels et n’ont jamais collaboré avec les FDLR ou d’autres groupes armés étrangers » , peut-on lire dans le document.

The outlet added that a military aircraft had been overflying Minembwe, and that the Congolese government and the FARDC had not reacted.

src: Le MRDP-Twirwaneho indique que des avions de chasse Sukhoi et des drones sont mobilisés pour soutenir les forces au sol. Ces moyens aériens viseraient à frapper les positions du MRDP-Twirwaneho et des villages civils. “Ce plan est coordonné par le Général Pacifique Masunzu depuis Kisangani,” souligne le mouvement.
Pour l’heure, le gouvernement congolais et les FARDC n’ont pas réagi.

r1-SKS-2025Q4-001.l: Bangwi, near Makobola (Fizi / Uvira border), South Kivu
r1-SKS-2025Q4-001.a: AFC/M23 rebels; attackers not named by the source in this passage

src: Selon nos sources, les combats ont éclaté dimanche après une attaque contre les rebelles de l'AFC/M23 dans le village de Bangwi où d’intenses affrontements ont duré toute la journée provoquant le déplacement massif de la population vers Swima et Mboko.

r1-SKS-2025Q4-002.s: Actualite.cd quoted M'massa Etùba, president of civil society of the Babungwe sud grouping, as saying that since the taking of Makobola the last AFC/M23 position was at Bangwi near the Iàmba health centre (Nundu health zone), the Wazalendo were in the Pemba escarpments and the FARDC at Kasekezi and Ngalula.
r1-SKS-2025Q4-002.l: Makobola, Bangwi, Kasekezi, Ngalula, Pemba (Fizi territory), South Kivu
r1-SKS-2025Q4-002.n: Single civil-society source quoted by a Congolese outlet. The source does not give the date of the capture of Makobola (other outlets, not fetched here, put it around 14 December). Positions as of Monday 22 Dec 2025 (page date).
r1-SKS-2025Q4-002.vn: Verbatim on page; single civil-society speaker quoted by the outlet; positions as told on 22 Dec. excerpt_en flags checked: the English renders the excerpt alone (capitalisation/expanded acronyms only).
src: Depuis la prise de Makobola, la dernière position de l’AFC/M23 est à Bangwi tout près du centre de santé Iàmba dans la zone de santé de Nundu, tandis que les wazalendo sont dans les escarpements de Pemba. Les FARDC sont à Kasekezi et à Ngalula", a dit à ACTUALITE.CD , M'massa Etùba
M'massa Etùba, le président de la société civile du groupement des Babungwe sud.

r1-SKS-2025Q4-003.s: Actualite.cd reported that, despite FARDC reinforcements to the Wazalendo from Kalemie, the town of Mboko, 55 km north of Baraka, remained under the control of AFC-M23 fighters.
r1-SKS-2025Q4-003.n: Source does not say when Mboko was taken; the 12 Dec Actualite.cd report (claim on Mboko displacement) describes Mboko as not yet reached by rebels, so the capture falls between 12 and 22 Dec 2025 on these two pages. src: Malgré les renforts des FARDC aux wazalendo en provence de Kalemie, la cité de Mboko située à 55 km au nord de la ville de Baraka reste toujours sous contrôle des combattants de l’AFC-M23.

r1-SKS-2025Q4-004.s: Actualite.cd reported, citing its sources, that the AFC/M23 had deployed a marine unit on Lake Tanganyika that took part in the fighting, and that after a Wazalendo attack on Monday the 'marins' of the AFC/M23 fired from the lake.

src: Selon les sources d’ ACTUALITE.CD , les rebelles ont déployé une unité marine sur le lac Tanganyika et cette dernière participe également aux combats.

Au moins trente maisons ont été pillées dans la nuit de vendredi à samedi et quatre jeunes filles y ont été violées.

La population dénonce notamment des pillages systématiques, des cas de viols, diverses violences physiques, ainsi que des tirs répétés et incontrôlés durant la nuit, provoquant une psychose généralisée au sein des quartiers.

src: Au moins trente maisons ont été pillées dans la nuit de vendredi à samedi et quatre jeunes filles y ont été violées.
Sous la menace d’éventuels débordements, la population vit dans la peur : écoles fermées depuis trois jours, marché paralysé, commerces et boutiques clos par crainte de nouveaux pillages.

r1-SKS-2025Q4-007.s: Actualite.cd reported that on Saturday morning at about 10:00 local time an exchange of fire broke out in Katanga commune of Baraka, in which a soldier was killed by Wazalendo elements and a civilian was wounded; it added that FARDC units and Wazalendo factions were visible in the town.
r1-SKS-2025Q4-007.l: Katanga commune, Baraka, Fizi territory, South Kivu
r1-SKS-2025Q4-007.a: Wazalendo elements (alleged killers of the soldier); the soldier's unit is given only as FARDC in the same article
r1-SKS-2025Q4-007.x: Actualite.cd: one soldier killed, one civilian wounded
r1-SKS-2025Q4-007.n: Page does not say which army the soldier belonged to; the following sentence says units of the FARDC and Wazalendo factions are visible in the town. Date is Saturday per publication date of 2025-12-13 ('ce samedi').
r1-SKS-2025Q4-007.vn: Typo fixed ('civil' -> 'civilian'). Soldier's army not stated by the page. 'ce samedi' gives the day: approximate per weekday rule. 10:00 is the source's '10h'.
src: Dans la matinée, vers 10h locales, des échanges de tirs ont éclaté dans la commune de Katanga : un militaire a été tué par des éléments Wazalendo et un civil a été blessé.

r1-SKS-2025Q4-008.s: Actualite.cd reported, from its first information, that the FARDC and Wazalendo groups had set up a position at Makobola, about 80 km from Baraka, where the Wazalendo chief William Yakutumba was said to be based, and that the AFC/M23, already in Uvira, would first have to cross that position to advance on Baraka.
r1-SKS-2025Q4-008.l: Makobola, Fizi / Uvira border, South Kivu
r1-SKS-2025Q4-008.n: Position as of 13 Dec 2025; Actualite.cd of 22 Dec (other claim) describes the rebels as having taken Makobola in the meantime. Yakutumba's presence is 'said to be' (conditional) in the source.
r1-SKS-2025Q4-008.vn: Verbatim; conditional ('serait installé', 'devraient') preserved. '23' flag is the M23 name.
src: Dans la région, les FARDC et des groupes Wazalendo ont établi une position à Makobola, à environ 80 km de Baraka. C’est là que serait installé le chef Wazalendo William Yakutumba, selon les premières informations recueillies par ACTUALITE.CD.

r1-SKS-2025Q4-009.s: FiziMedia reported, citing an alert by the coordinator of the youth group CJIOP, Orphée ‘Yamone’a Kamengele, and several concordant local sources, that the population of Baraka faced serious human rights violations attributed to FARDC elements who had fled the recent fighting in Uvira, denouncing systematic looting, cases of rape, physical violence and repeated uncontrolled gunfire at night, and that voices were demanding the immediate transfer of these FARDC elements to Kalemie.
r1-SKS-2025Q4-009.a: FARDC elements who had fled the Uvira fighting
r1-SKS-2025Q4-009.x: not stated (number of rape cases not given)
r1-SKS-2025Q4-009.n: Local outlet (FiziMedia, Fizi/Baraka) relaying a civil-society alert; no dates for individual incidents, no figures. Same period and place as the Actualite.cd report of the night of 12-13 Dec. Not independently confirmed.
r1-SKS-2025Q4-009.vn: Narrowed: the page says 'des voix s’élèvent' demand the transfer, not that the population demanded it; added the night-gunfire element printed in excerpt 2. Allegation kept attributed to the CJIOP alert/local sources; separate from Actualite.cd's unattributed account (#4). No incident dates or counts on the page. excerpt_en flags checked: the English renders the excerpt alone (capitalisation/expanded acronyms only). 2026-10-28 corroboration pass: partially_corroborated; added 1 source(s) whose excerpts were matched on the live page. 2026-10-29: source 3 excerpt_en edited: QA 0.4 A3: non-English excerpt shown without an English translation; translation added, marked as one
ent: Cabinet des jeunes Intégrès pour l’orientation des politiques en RDC
src: la population civile fait face à de graves violations des droits humains attribuées à des éléments des Forces Armées de la République Démocratique du Congo (FARDC) ayant fui les récents affrontements à Uvira.
Selon une alerte publiée par le coordonnateur du Cabinet des jeunes Intégrès pour l’orientation des politiques en RDC, CJIOP, Orphée ‘Yamone’a Kamengele et plusieurs sources locales concordantes

La population dénonce notamment des pillages systématiques, des cas de viols, diverses violences physiques, ainsi que des tirs répétés et incontrôlés durant la nuit, provoquant une psychose généralisée au sein des quartiers.
Au moins trente maisons ont été pillées dans la nuit de vendredi à samedi et quatre jeunes filles y ont été violées.

r1-SKS-2025Q4-010.s: Médecins Sans Frontières (MSF) said in a press release that, because of the intensification of fighting between the AFC/M23 and the Congolese army and its Wazalendo allies in South Kivu, it had no choice but to interrupt prematurely its medical activities in Baraka (Fizi health zone) for security reasons, that it had evacuated its teams from the town, and that medical activities at Baraka general hospital and in three health centres had ended.
r1-SKS-2025Q4-010.l: Baraka, Fizi health zone, Fizi territory, South Kivu
r1-SKS-2025Q4-010.a: MSF (organisation affected); fighting between AFC/M23 and the Congolese army and Wazalendo allies
r1-SKS-2025Q4-010.x: MSF: more than 25 000 people treated for malaria in Baraka between August and December
r1-SKS-2025Q4-010.n: Primary NGO release. A closure for security reasons, not an attack on a facility. The release also says the closure was initially planned for end of January 2026; it says the capture of Uvira, about a hundred kilometres from Baraka, preceded the evacuation.
r1-SKS-2025Q4-010.vn: Release (dated 12 Décembre 2025 on page) supports all; release date removed from the statement (shown with the source). A security closure, not an attack. Figures narrowed to what excerpt 2 prints. excerpt_en flags checked: the English renders the excerpt alone (capitalisation/expanded acronyms only). MSF says the closure had been planned for end of January and was brought forward; it links the evacuation to the M23 capture of Uvira, about a hundred kilometres away. 2026-10-28 corroboration pass: same_origin_only; added 2 source(s) whose excerpts were matched on the live page. 2026-10-29: source 3 excerpt_en edited: QA 0.4 A3: non-English excerpt shown without an English translation; translation added, marked as one 2026-10-29: source 4 excerpt_en edited: QA 0.4 A3: non-English excerpt shown without an English translation; translation added, marked as one
src: Face à l'intensification des combats entre l'AFC/M23 et l'armée congolaise et leurs alliés Wazalendo dans le Sud-Kivu, MSF n'a pas d'autre choix que d'interrompre prématurément ses activités médicales à Baraka, dans la zone de santé de Fizi, pour des raisons de sécurité.
MSF a évacué ses équipes de la ville. Les activités médicales à l’hôpital général de Baraka ainsi que dans trois centres de santé sont terminées.
Entre août et décembre, les équipes de MSF à Baraka ont pris en charge plus de 25 000 personnes atteintes de paludisme.
Les activités médicales à l’hôpital général de Baraka, ainsi que dans trois centres de santé, sont désormais terminées, indique l’ONG.
L’organisation précise avoir évacué ses équipes après l’avancée du M23 et la prise de la ville d’Uvira

r1-SKS-2025Q4-011.s: FiziMedia reported, according to concordant local sources, that the general referral hospital of Mi’enge, in the Itombwe grouping (Mwenga territory), was vandalised and largely destroyed in the night of Tuesday 30 December 2025 by elements of the Twirwaneho rebellion, allied to the M23-AFC, and that medicines, medical equipment and other essential material were looted.
r1-SKS-2025Q4-011.l: Mi’enge, Itombwe grouping, Mwenga territory, South Kivu
r1-SKS-2025Q4-011.a: Twirwaneho (described by the source as allied to the M23-AFC)
r1-SKS-2025Q4-011.n: Single local outlet (FiziMedia, Fizi), published 2026-01-01; the event falls on 30 Dec 2025. Same outlet reports local civil society condemned the attack. Twirwaneho/AFC-M23 account not found (see gaps). Spelling Mi’enge as printed (also Mienge, Mibunda in other outlets).
r1-SKS-2025Q4-011.vn: Verbatim. The attribution to Twirwaneho is FiziMedia's narration resting on unnamed local sources; one local outlet, no second source, no Twirwaneho/AFC-M23 response: grade C. Single local source (FiziMedia) for both the destruction and its attribution to Twirwaneho; not independently corroborated.
src: L’Hôpital général de référence de Mi’enge, situé au chef-lieu du groupement d’Itombwe en territoire de Mwenga, a été vandalisé et en grande partie détruit dans la nuit du mardi 30 décembre 2025 par des éléments de la rébellion Twirwaneho, alliée au mouvement M23-AFC.

Selon des sources locales concordantes, les assaillants se sont emparés de cette structure sanitaire avant de procéder à sa destruction systématique. Des médicaments, équipements médicaux et autres matériels essentiels ont été pillés
Pour l’heure, aucune réaction officielle des autorités provinciales ou nationales n’a encore été enregistrée

r1-SKS-2025Q4-012.s: Factuel.cd reported that on Thursday 6 November 2025 fighting continued for the third consecutive day in the Itombwe highlands (Mwenga territory), opposing Wazalendo of the Front de Défense du Congo (FDCC), led by General Kakobanya Nakalambi Justin, to a rebel coalition of AFC-M23, RDF, Twirwaneho, Red Tabara and FNL/Zabampema; per local sources the fighting was particularly violent around Tuwetuwe, where the coalition tried to take a FARDC-held position and FARDC supported by FDCC Wazalendo repelled the attack.
r1-SKS-2025Q4-012.l: Itombwe highlands, Tuwetuwe, Mwenga territory (and parts of Fizi), South Kivu
r1-SKS-2025Q4-012.a: FDCC Wazalendo (Gen. Kakobanya Nakalambi Justin) and FARDC vs a coalition of AFC-M23, RDF, Twirwaneho, Red Tabara and FNL/Zabampema, as named by the source
r1-SKS-2025Q4-012.x: Factuel.cd: no precise casualty figure communicated by any official source
r1-SKS-2025Q4-012.n: Single Kinshasa outlet, 'third consecutive day' implies the fighting began about 4 Nov, which matches the Kivu Morning Post account of 4 Nov at Mikenge (separate claim). The RDF presence is as named by the source; no RDF or AFC/M23 account found. Participation of RDF is an attribution by the outlet, not verified.
r1-SKS-2025Q4-012.vn: Verbatim (Factuel.cd, byline Jephté Matondo). RDF participation is the outlet's own characterisation, not independently verified; start date 4 Nov inferred from 'third consecutive day' (range). excerpt_en flags checked: the English renders the excerpt alone (capitalisation/expanded acronyms only).
src: Les affrontements se poursuivent pour le troisième jour consécutif, ce jeudi 6 novembre 2025, dans les hauts plateaux d’Itombwe, territoire de Mwenga, au Sud-Kivu.

Ils opposent les Wazalendo du Front de Défense du Congo (FDCC), conduits par le général Kakobanya Nakalambi Justin, à une coalition rebelle regroupant les forces de l’AFC-M23, du RDF, ainsi que des groupes armés Twirwaneho, Red Tabara et FNL/Zabampema.
