src: Lors du Conseil des ministres du vendredi 10 octobre 2025, la Première ministre Judith Suminwa a qualifié la main tendue du président Félix Tshisekedi à son homologue rwandais Paul Kagame comme une « quête sincère » pour la paix.

r1-ST-DRC-2025-009.s: Radio Okapi reported that Prime Minister Judith Suminwa Tuluka, opening the 58th session of the UN Human Rights Council in Geneva on Monday 24 February, called for 'dissuasive sanctions against Rwanda'.
r1-ST-DRC-2025-009.l: Geneva (statement on Goma and Bukavu situation)
r1-ST-DRC-2025-009.vn: Excerpt confirmed. 'Opening' is a slight compression of 'intervenant à l'ouverture' (speaking at the opening); acceptable. excerpt_en flag is the expanded acronym only.
src: Intervenant à l’ouverture, ce lundi 24 février à Genève (Suisse) de la 58ème session du Conseil des droits de l’homme (CDH), la Première ministre Judith Suminwa Tuluka a appelé « à des sanctions dissuasives contre le Rwanda »

r1-ST-DRC-2025-010.s: In an interview with NotreAfrik published by Wakat Séra, Prime Minister Judith Suminwa Tuluka said the M23 and Rwanda are 'intrinsically linked' and that any serious negotiation should be held directly with Rwanda.
r1-ST-DRC-2025-010.l: Kinshasa (statement on the M23 and Rwanda)
r1-ST-DRC-2025-010.n: Publication date 19 Feb 2025 is the date of the republication; interview date not stated.
r1-ST-DRC-2025-010.vn: Quote is the PM's answer to the question on negotiating with M23 and Rwanda; page credits NotreAfrik ('Chez nos confrères', 'Source: NotreAfrik'). Kinshasa location is not printed, but it is not a clause of the statement. Interview date not printed; the page dates the republication 19 Feb 2025 and places the interview after the AU summit.
src: Pour nous, la position est claire : le M23 et le Rwanda sont intrinsèquement liés. Comme l’a déjà souligné le Président de la République, toute négociation sérieuse devrait se faire directement avec le Rwanda.

r1-ST-DRC-2025-011.s: Actualite.cd reported that the Prime Minister's office said Judith Suminwa was preparing to speak at the African Union Peace and Security Council on behalf of the Head of State with force and determination, putting forward her country's precise expectations.
r1-ST-DRC-2025-011.l: Addis Ababa (statement on the conflict in eastern DRC)
r1-ST-DRC-2025-011.n: The same page records the Primature figure of more than 3,000 lives lost in Goma, a claim not cited here.
r1-ST-DRC-2025-011.vn: Excerpt confirmed; PSC context from the same page. A statement of intent by the Prime Minister's office before the meeting, not a record of what was said at it.
src: Judith Suminwa se prépare à prendre la parole au nom du Chef de l'État avec force et détermination, mettant en avant les attentes précises de son pays", dit la Primature.

r1-ST-DRC-2025-012.s: DW reported that President Félix Tshisekedi intensified his accusations against Rwanda, criticising decades of what he described as 'predatory aggression' against the DRC, at the Munich Security Conference.
r1-ST-DRC-2025-012.l: Munich (statement on North and South Kivu conflict)
r1-ST-DRC-2025-012.n: BBC (cvgmj00zjrpo, 15 Feb) separately reported, citing AFP, that he called for Rwanda to be sanctioned; not cited. Conference dates 14-16 February per DW.
r1-ST-DRC-2025-012.vn: Excerpt confirmed; date range 14-16 Feb is printed on the page (replacement quote). Speech day within the conference is not stated, so the range stands.
src: Congolese President Felix Tshisekedi has intensified his accusations against Rwanda , issuing a scathing critique against decades of what he described as "predatory aggression" against the Democratic Republic of Congo at the recent Munich Security Conference .

r1-ST-DRC-2025-013.s: The UN General Assembly's summary of President Félix-Antoine Tshisekedi's address said he stated that the withdrawal of Rwandan troops and an end to support for M23 are non-negotiable conditions for real peace.
r1-ST-DRC-2025-013.n: Page is dated 23 Sept 2025; Africanews gives 24 Sept for the address (not fetched). The summary is a UN rapporteur's paraphrase, not a transcript. Debate: 80th session.
r1-ST-DRC-2025-013.vn: Confirmed on the UN page, which prints the 23 Sept 2025 date and cites press.un.org as the summary source. UN rapporteur's summary, not a transcript; the page dates the statement 23 September 2025.
src: He commended the leadership of President Trump for paving the way to dialogue leading to the signing in Washington, D.C., of a peace agreement between the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Rwanda. The withdrawal of Rwandan troops and an end to support for M23 are non-negotiable conditions for real peace.

r1-ST-DRC-2025-014.s: Radio Okapi reported that government spokesperson Patrick Muyaya welcomed the 19 July signature in Doha, under Qatari facilitation, of a declaration of principles between the Congolese government and the AFC/M23, which he said contains clear commitments on civilian protection, national sovereignty and peace consolidation.
r1-ST-DRC-2025-014.l: Kinshasa; Doha (declaration concerning North and South Kivu)
r1-ST-DRC-2025-014.n: Only the welcome and the signature are in the excerpt; commitments listed on the page are not cited. Rwanda MFA also welcomed the declaration (lead: facebook.com/RwandaMFA, not fetched).
r1-ST-DRC-2025-014.vn: Both clauses confirmed on the page; the commitments clause rests on the page passage, not the stored excerpt (excerpt gap). 2026-10-29: source 0 excerpt_en edited: QA 0.4 A3: non-English excerpt shown without an English translation; translation added, marked as one
src: Le porte-parole du gouvernement de la République démocratique du Congo (RDC), Patrick Muyaya, a salué samedi 19 juillet à Kinshasa, la signature d’une déclaration de principes entre le Gouvernement congolais et la rébellion de l’AFC/M23, ce même samedi à Doha, sous la facilitation du Qatar.

r1-ST-DRC-2025-015.s: Beto.cd reported that the military governor of North Kivu, Maj Gen Evariste Somo Kakule, said armed youths unidentified clashed with AFC/M23 fighters at Kalangira, Baswagha chiefdom (Lubero), and, in a communique, that the incident did not involve the FARDC, which remain faithful to the ceasefire.
r1-ST-DRC-2025-015.l: Kalangira, Baswagha chiefdom, Lubero territory, North Kivu
r1-ST-DRC-2025-015.n: Territory (Lubero) is from the article headline, not the excerpt. Same page says, per the governor's spokesperson, that three notables (Mumbere Charles, Kakule Mulokya Block, Solo Manzu Bungwe) were allegedly arrested by AFC/M23 and tortured; see next claim. Date is the page date.
r1-ST-DRC-2025-015.vn: Both passages confirmed. Byline credit to AFP is ambiguous on the page and is recorded rather than resolved. The page header reads 'AFP Rédaction Kinshasa'; the text may be or draw on AFP copy. Lubero territory is from the headline. Date is the page date (26 Oct 2025); the clash date is not printed. 2026-10-29: source 0 excerpt_en edited: QA 0.4 A3: non-English excerpt shown without an English translation; translation added, marked as one 2026-10-29: source 1 excerpt_en edited: QA 0.4 A3: non-English excerpt shown without an English translation; translation added, marked as one
src: Selon le gouverneur militaire du Nord-Kivu, le général-major Evariste Somo Kakule, ces échanges de tirs ont opposé un groupe de jeunes armés non identifiés aux combattants de l’AFC/M23 dans la localité de Kalangira, en chefferie de Baswagha.

Dans un communiqué officiel, le gouverneur a précisé que cet incident n’engage en rien les FARDC, lesquelles restent fidèles au respect du cessez-le-feu, conformément à l’accord de Washington signé entre la RDC et le Rwanda, ainsi qu’à la déclaration de principes de Doha conclue entre la RDC et l’AFC/M23.

r1-ST-DRC-2025-016.s: Beto.cd reported that, according to the spokesperson of the North Kivu military governor, Lt Marc Elongo, three notables had been arrested and abducted five days earlier by the AFC/M23 official in the locality of Kisanga, near Masereka, and had allegedly then been transferred to Kipese, where they were allegedly detained and tortured; the page says the army reported this was confirmed after an emergency provincial security council meeting, and names the three detained persons, with a hedge ('seraient'), as Mumbere Charles, Kakule Mulokya Block and Solo Manzu Bungwe.
r1-ST-DRC-2025-016.l: Kisanga, Masereka; Kipese, Lubero territory, North Kivu
r1-ST-DRC-2025-016.a: AFC/M23 (as alleged by the military governor's spokesperson)
r1-ST-DRC-2025-016.n: Single-source, official Congolese allegation; no AFC/M23 response found. Source in the first excerpt quotes spokesperson Lt Marc Elongo; this excerpt only prints the names, and the attribution sits in the preceding passage of the page. Date range computed from 'il y a cinq jours'.
r1-ST-DRC-2025-016.vn: All passages confirmed on the page. Corrected so the names carry the source's hedge and sit in the army's account rather than as an established list, and the army's stated cross-check (Beni security council) is recorded as its claim. Names spelled as printed. A single Congolese military-authority allegation relayed by one outlet; the names are printed in the conditional ('seraient'). No AFC/M23 response found. Date range is computed from 'il y a cinq jours' on a 26 Oct 2025 page. 2026-10-29: source 0 excerpt_en edited: QA 0.4 A3: non-English excerpt shown without an English translation; translation added, marked as one 2026-10-29: source 1 excerpt_en edited: QA 0.4 A3: non-English excerpt shown without an English translation; translation added, marked as one
src: Ces jeunes armés seraient intervenus pour tenter de libérer trois de leurs notables arrêtés et enlevés il y a cinq jours par le responsable de l’AFC/M23 dans la localité de Kisanga, près de Masereka. Ces personnes auraient ensuite été transférées manu militari à Kipese, où elles seraient détenues et victimes d’actes de torture », a déclaré le lieutenant Marc Elongo, porte-parole du gouverneur.
Les trois personnes détenues seraient Mumbere Charles, Kakule Mulokya Block et Solo Manzu Bungwe.

r1-ST-DRC-2026-001.s: Forum des As reported that government spokesperson Patrick Muyaya wrote in a post on X on Thursday 23 July that demanding the participation of the 'son', M23/AFC, in the dialogue between Congolese was directly demanding that of the 'father', Rwanda; the outlet added that the government considers the links between the rebel movement and Kigali established.
r1-ST-DRC-2026-001.n: Forum des As relays a post by Muyaya (X, 23 July 2026 per social_posts lead); date of article 24 July. Statement is the government's position, attributed.
r1-ST-DRC-2026-001.vn: Draft credited Actualite.cd; the only source is Forum des As. The X post is dated Thursday 23 July on the page; the article is of 24 July. excerpt_en flag: the translation matches the excerpt (the extra capitals are translation artefacts). The government's position, attributed. The line on Kigali links is Forum des As narration of the government view.
src: « Réclamer la participation du fils, M23/AFC, au dialogue entre Congolais, n’est-ce pas réclamer directement la participation du père, le Rwanda ? », a-t-il écrit. Le Gouvernement considère, en effet, que les liens entre le mouvement rebelle et Kigali sont avérés.

r1-ST-DRC-2026-002.s: Forum des As reported that Muyaya said the dialogue announced by President Tshisekedi is intended for national actors who have not taken up arms and must remain complementary to the diplomatic processes in Washington and Doha.
r1-ST-DRC-2026-002.vn: Excerpt on the page and supports each clause.
src: Patrick Muyaya rappelle, par ailleurs, que le dialogue voulu par le chef de l’État est destiné aux acteurs nationaux n’ayant pas pris les armes. Il précise également que cette initiative devra rester complémentaire aux processus diplomatiques en cours, notamment ceux engagés à Washington et à Doha.

r1-ST-DRC-2026-003.s: Actualite.cd reported that the South Kivu provincial government, led by Governor Jean-Jacques Purusi from Uvira, denounced the 'insufficiency, even inaction' of the AFC/M23 rebels administering Bukavu after a fire, and the pressure and 'predation' of the population under their administration.
r1-ST-DRC-2026-003.n: Party statement (Kinshasa-aligned provincial government); communiqué dated 10 Sept 2026 per article. Fire occurred at Cimpunda, Kadutu commune.
r1-ST-DRC-2026-003.vn: All clauses on the page; the Purusi/Uvira clause is in the article lead, not the stored excerpt. Party statement (Kinshasa-aligned provincial government).
src: « Le Gouvernement provincial dénonce avec la plus grande fermeté l’insuffisance, voire l’inaction des Rebelles de l’AFC/M23 qui administrent actuellement la ville de Bukavu, face à une situation qui exige pourtant une mobilisation permanente.

r1-ST-DRC-2026-004.s: Actualite.cd reported that a fire on Thursday 10 September ravaged two schools in Kadutu commune, Bukavu, killing pupils, with about twenty others wounded, provisional figures it said were confirmed by medical sources and the AFC/M23 authorities; Radio Okapi reported a provisional toll of 29 children dead from hospital sources.
r1-ST-DRC-2026-004.a: not applicable (fire; cause not attributed to an armed actor)
r1-ST-DRC-2026-004.x: Actualite.cd: at least 20 pupils dead, about twenty wounded (provisional; medical sources and AFC/M23 authorities). Provincial government communiqué cited by Actualite.cd: more than 26 children dead. Radio Okapi: 29 children dead (provisional, hospital sources). Figures not merged.
r1-ST-DRC-2026-004.n: Context event (non-conflict) kept because it produced party statements about AFC/M23 administration of Bukavu. Figures differ between sources (Actualite.cd cites provincial communiqué 26+ children; Radio Okapi 29); Radio Okapi names avenue Kasheke, Actualite.cd names Cimpunda quarter. Not an allegation of violence.
r1-ST-DRC-2026-004.vn: Draft omitted the death toll Actualite.cd gives; figures field corrected so each source's figure stands separately. Two independent outlets with separate origins. The Actualite.cd toll (at least 20) is on the page but not in the stored excerpt, so it sits in figures and the note, not the statement. Context event only (accidental fire, not attributed to any armed actor); kept because it produced party statements on AFC/M23 administration of Bukavu. Tolls differ by source: at least 20 (Actualite.cd), more than 26 (provincial communiqué), 29 (Radio Okapi). Actualite.cd names the Ujamaa and Furaha primary schools in Cimpunda; Radio Okapi names avenue Kasheke and a stampede during the fire.
src: Une vingtaine d'autres sont blessés et pris en charge dans les hôpitaux de la ville. Ces chiffres encore provisoires sont confirmés à ACTUALITE.CD par des sources médicales et les autorités de la rébellion de l’AFC/M23.

Les réactions continuent de se multiplier à Bukavu, ville sous contrôle de l’AFC-M23, après la mort de 29 enfants survenue jeudi 10 septembre 2026 sur l’avenue Kasheke. Ce bilan encore provisoire émane des sources hospitalières.

r1-ST-DRC-2026-005.s: Actualite.cd reported that the United States, via Massad Boulos on X, acknowledged the first transport and transfer of 15 detainees from DRC authorities to AFC/M23 under the Doha prisoner-exchange mechanism.
r1-ST-DRC-2026-005.n: Mediator statement. A Swahili lead (Instagram, unfetched) says M23 refused six of the 15 handed over: not confirmed, not cited.
r1-ST-DRC-2026-005.vn: Excerpt verbatim on the page; no wire credit. Unconfirmed Swahili lead on refused detainees correctly left out. Mediator statement. 'First' is the speaker's own word.
src: « Les Etats-Unis reconnaissent le premier transport et transfert de 15 détenus des autorités de la RDC vers l’AFC/M23 dans le cadre du mécanisme d’échange de prisonniers du cadre de Doha », a déclaré sur X Massad Boulos, conseiller principal américain pour l’Afrique

r1-ST-DRC-2026-006.s: Actualite.cd reported that the transfer of fifteen detainees took place on 6 and 7 August, facilitated by the ICRC; the detainees left Beni, transited through Uganda and were handed to AFC/M23 in Rutshuru territory.
r1-ST-DRC-2026-006.n: Names of the detainees not printed.
r1-ST-DRC-2026-006.vn: Supported clause by clause. The detainees are not named on the page.
src: L’opération, menée les 6 et 7 août, a été facilitée par le Comité international de la Croix-Rouge (CICR). Les quinze détenus ont quitté Beni, dans l’est de la République démocratique du Congo, avant de transiter par l’Ouganda et d’être remis à l’AFC/M23 dans le territoire de Rutshuru.

r1-ST-DRC-2026-007.s: Actualite.cd reported that the Front pour la refondation de la nation (FRN), led by Joseph Kabila, announced in a political declaration dated 12 October in Goma that it ended the existence of the Alliance Fleuve Congo, which it 'succeeds by right', and aims to fight Kinshasa 'by all means including force'.
r1-ST-DRC-2026-007.a: FRN (successor to AFC), led by Joseph Kabila
r1-ST-DRC-2026-007.n: Partisan declaration reported by a Congolese outlet; the outlet notes the text does not say what becomes of M23 separately and sets no operational timetable.
r1-ST-DRC-2026-007.vn: Supported; 'succeeds by right' clause is on the page beyond the stored excerpt. The FRN's own declaration (AFC/M23 successor). Actualite.cd notes the text does not say separately what becomes of M23 and sets no operational timetable.
ent: Front pour la refondation de la nation
src: Le Front pour la refondation de la nation (FRN), dirigé par Joseph Kabila, annonce mettre fin à l’existence de l’Alliance Fleuve Congo (AFC) et se donne pour mission de combattre le pouvoir de Kinshasa « par tous les moyens y compris la force », selon une déclaration politique datée du 12 octobre à Goma.

r1-ST-DRC-2026-008.s: Actualite.cd reported that FARDC spokesperson Major-General Sylvain Ekenge said that at the meeting chaired by President Tshisekedi the army chief of staff presented the operational situation and the commander-in-chief gave instructions to the defence and security forces.
r1-ST-DRC-2026-008.n: Meeting date 14 Oct per article body ('mercredi 14 octobre 2026').
r1-ST-DRC-2026-008.vn: Supported; date 14 October confirmed in the article lead. Actualite.cd describes the meeting as the Conseil supérieur de la Défense, held on Wednesday 14 October 2026.
src: Selon le porte-parole des FARDC, le général-major Sylvain Ekenge, après la présentation de la situation sur le terrain, le chef de l’État a donné des instructions précises aux forces de défense et de sécurité.

r1-ST-DRC-2026-009.s: The Kivu Morning Post reported that the FRN accused Kinshasa's forces on Thursday 22 October 2026 of preparing generalised attacks, saying the army bombarded the Rugezi zone in the Minembwe region, South Kivu, with kamikaze drones and heavy artillery in the night of 21 to 22 October.
r1-ST-DRC-2026-009.l: Rugezi zone, Minembwe region, South Kivu (territory not stated by the source)
r1-ST-DRC-2026-009.n: FRN allegation only; no FARDC response found for this specific allegation (see gaps). Territory (Fizi vs Mwenga) not stated by source; Minembwe is in Fizi territory per common usage but left as Fizi tentatively.
r1-ST-DRC-2026-009.vn: Statement unchanged; location corrected: the source does not name Fizi or Mwenga territory, so the inferred territory is removed. Partisan origin. FRN (AFC/M23 successor) allegation only; no FARDC response found.
src: Selon le FRN, l’armée a bombardé, dans la nuit du 21 au 22 octobre 2026, la zone de Rugezi, dans la région de Minembwe, au Sud-Kivu, à l’aide de drones kamikazes et d’artillerie lourde.

r1-ST-DRC-2026-010.s: The Kivu Morning Post reported that the FRN communiqué also reported reinforcement of troops and military equipment at Luvungi and Lubarika and movements of Burundian troops crossing the Ruzizi river towards the Ruzizi plain, where, according to the communiqué, they would join other military elements.
r1-ST-DRC-2026-010.l: Luvungi, Lubarika, Ruzizi plain, South Kivu
r1-ST-DRC-2026-010.n: FRN allegation; Burundi response not found.
r1-ST-DRC-2026-010.vn: Narrowed to the source's wording, keeping its conditional; partisan origin. FRN allegation; the onward move is conditional in the source ('rejoindraient'). No Burundi or FARDC response found.
src: Le communiqué fait aussi état d’un renforcement des troupes et des équipements militaires à Luvungi et à Lubarika. Il signale par ailleurs des mouvements de troupes burundaises traversant la rivière Ruzizi en direction de la plaine de la Ruzizi, où elles rejoindraient d’autres éléments militaires.

r1-ST-DRC-2026-011.s: Radio Okapi reported that in a communiqué published on Monday 24 August 2026 the DRC government accused the Rwanda Defence Forces (RDF) and their AFC/M23 auxiliaries of summary executions, sexual violence, torture and abductions, citing consolidated data of more than 300 people killed in June and July 2026.
r1-ST-DRC-2026-011.l: AFC/M23-held areas, North and South Kivu
r1-ST-DRC-2026-011.a: DRC Government; alleged perpetrators per government: RDF and AFC/M23
r1-ST-DRC-2026-011.x: DRC government: more than 300 killed in June and July 2026
r1-ST-DRC-2026-011.n: Government allegation, not independently verified; the page's URL slug is truncated in search results but fetched successfully. AFC/M23 and Rwandan responses not found (see gaps).
r1-ST-DRC-2026-011.vn: Both sources are one page and one origin (not two independent origins). Figures stay attributed to the government. Government allegation, figures attributed to the government and not independently verified. The same communiqué also alleges hundreds of rapes and sexual assaults and more than 300 torture cases (Radio Okapi).
src: Dans un communiqué publié ce lundi 24 août 2026, Kinshasa accuse les Forces de défense rwandaises (RDF) et leurs supplétifs de l’AFC/M23 d’être responsables d’exécutions sommaires, de violences sexuelles, de tortures et d’enlèvements.

Selon les données consolidées citées par le gouvernement dans ce document, plus de 300 personnes ont été tuées en juin et juillet 2026dans des exécutions sommaires, des massacres et des bombardements.

r1-ST-DRC-2026-012.s: Radio Okapi reported that the same government communiqué asserted that more than 100 families of Rwandan origin crossed the border via the Kabuhanga track in Nyiragongo territory on 10 August 2026 and were reportedly then settled at Rwibiranga (Buhumba groupement), and that Kinshasa denounced the imposition of taxes in areas controlled by the AFC/M23, including fees in schools and taxes reportedly imposed on health structures.
r1-ST-DRC-2026-012.a: DRC Government; alleged: Rwandan authorities and AFC/M23
r1-ST-DRC-2026-012.n: Single-party allegation about demographic change; Rwandan response not found.
r1-ST-DRC-2026-012.vn: Draft dropped the source's conditional on the settlement; restored. '23' flag is from 'M23' only. Grade aligned with claim 10 (same page, same origin): the claim is that the government said this. Single-party (government) allegation, not independently verified; the settlement at Rwibiranga is conditional in the source ('auraient'). Health-care relevance: alleged taxation of public and private hospitals in AFC/M23-held areas. 2026-10-28: source 0 sources.append edited: fact-check fc1: Radio Okapi, 24 Aug 2026. Every clause is on the page, but the stored excerpt carries only the 10 August border-crossing sentence; the Rwibiranga, taxes and health-structures passages are added.
