r1-UC-RDF-019.s: The UN Group of Experts reported that in an interview with Jeune Afrique on 26 March 2026 President Paul Kagame rejected Rwanda's responsibility in the DRC conflict, portraying it as a Congolese internal issue.
r1-UC-RDF-019.n: Report's summary of the interview; the interview itself was not opened. Excerpt carries a footnote marker (382).
r1-UC-RDF-019.vn: Annex 19 of S/2026/466 verbatim. The Group's summary of the interview (Annex 19); the interview itself was not opened.
src: In an exclusive interview granted to Jeune Afrique on 26 March 2026, 382 President Paul Kagame addressed questions about Rwanda’s role in the ongoing conflict in the DRC, the US sanctions and the RDF’s expected withdrawal from the DRC. Kagame rejected Rwanda’s responsibility in the DRC conflict, portraying the conflict as a Congolese internal issue

r1-UC-RDF-020.s: Human Rights Watch reported that former detainees identified Rwandan soldiers during roundups and among instructors and commanders in the Rumangabo and Tshanzu camps (North Kivu), based on uniforms, equipment, accents and inability to speak French or Kiswahili, and that military, intelligence and UN sources confirmed Rwandan forces' involvement.
r1-UC-RDF-020.l: Rumangabo and Tshanzu camps, North Kivu
r1-UC-RDF-020.a: Rwandan forces and M23 (as alleged by HRW)
r1-UC-RDF-020.n: HRW interviewed 102 former detainees; the report period is mid-2024 to December 2025 (partly pre-window). Location Tshanzu per HRW text is in North Kivu.
r1-UC-RDF-020.vn: Both excerpts exact; camp names and period printed in the same release (page-only). excerpt_en faithful (omits the dash clause 'langues peu parlées au Rwanda', no additions). HRW's period (mid-2024 to December 2025) starts before the 1 January 2025 window. HRW interviewed 102 former detainees.
src: D’anciens détenus ont identifié des soldats rwandais lors de rafles et parmi les instructeurs et les commandants dans les camps en raison de leurs uniformes, de leur équipement, de leurs accents et de leur incapacité à s’exprimer en français ou en kiswahili – langues peu parlées au Rwanda – dans leurs conversations avec les détenus.
Des sources militaires et au sein des services de renseignement, ainsi que de l’ONU, ont confirmé l’implication des forces rwandaises.

r1-UC-RDF-021.s: Human Rights Watch said the Rwandan government and M23 leaders have long rejected allegations of abuses but have not conducted investigations.
r1-UC-RDF-021.a: Government of Rwanda; M23 leadership (as characterised by HRW)
r1-UC-RDF-021.n: HRW's characterisation, not a quote of a Rwandan statement; no direct Rwandan response to this report found.
r1-UC-RDF-021.vn: Exact; attribution to HRW kept. HRW's characterisation, not a Rwandan or M23 statement.
src: Le gouvernement rwandais et les dirigeants du M23 ont longtemps rejeté les allégations d’abus, mais n’ont pas mené d’enquêtes.

r1-UCD-FARDC-WZ-001.s: Kivu Morning Post reported that the Mouvement des Patriotes pour la Défense de la Patrie (MPDP), a Wazalendo armed group, announced its creation on Saturday 11 October 2025 in the city of Uvira, South Kivu.
r1-UCD-FARDC-WZ-001.n: Single local outlet (Goma-based). Article dated 2025-10-12; the creation date 11 Oct is the page's own.
r1-UCD-FARDC-WZ-001.vn: Excerpt prints creation announcement, date and place; flag is a translation artefact (expanded acronym). Rugenge location printed on page.
ent: Mouvement des Patriotes pour la Défense de la Patrie
src: Le Mouvement des Patriotes pour la Défense de la Patrie (MPDP), un groupe armé Wazalendo, a annoncé sa création ce samedi 11 octobre 2025 dans la ville d’Uvira, province du Sud-Kivu.

r1-UCD-FARDC-WZ-002.s: Kivu Morning Post reported that the MPDP is led by Pascal Biriho, alias Makanika, as commander of the forces, and by A. Byadunia Meschak Alexis as president of the political branch, and that both are former close collaborators of the warlord and former PNC officer Nyerere Bunana.
r1-UCD-FARDC-WZ-002.a: MPDP (Wazalendo): Pascal Biriho (commander of forces); A. Byadunia Meschak Alexis (political branch)
r1-UCD-FARDC-WZ-002.n: Single local outlet. 'Nyerere Bunana' is described by the source as 'seigneur de guerre et ex-officier de la PNC'; being named is not a finding of responsibility.
r1-UCD-FARDC-WZ-002.vn: Names and roles printed verbatim in excerpt. Being named is not a finding of responsibility.
src: Ce mouvement est dirigé par Pascal Biriho, alias Makanika, en qualité de commandant des forces, et par A. Byadunia Meschak Alexis, président de la branche politique. Tous deux sont d’anciens proches collaborateurs du seigneur de guerre et ex-officier de la PNC, Nyerere Bunana.

r1-UCD-FARDC-WZ-003.s: Kivu Morning Post reported that at the MPDP launch the RAD provincial coordinator for South Kivu, Alexis Dunia Mwamba, congratulated the MPDP commander while insisting on discipline and respect for the laws of the Republic, and symbolically handed a weapon to commander Pascal Biriho as a sign of support.
r1-UCD-FARDC-WZ-003.a: RAD South Kivu (Alexis Dunia Mwamba); MPDP (Pascal Biriho)
r1-UCD-FARDC-WZ-003.n: Single local outlet. The excerpt says the RAD coordinator handed a weapon 'à titre symbolique'. RAD is not expanded on the page (the Group of Experts calls it the Réserve armée de la défense).
r1-UCD-FARDC-WZ-003.vn: Both clauses printed on the same page (two excerpts).
src: Dans son discours, le coordonnateur provincial de la RAD au Sud-Kivu, Alexis Dunia Mwamba, a félicité le commandant du MPDP pour cette initiative, tout en insistant sur la discipline et le respect des lois de la République.
À titre symbolique, le coordonnateur de la RAD a remis une arme au commandant Pascal Biriho, en signe de soutien et d’accompagnement à ce nouveau venu au sein des groupes d’autodéfense Wazalendo.

r1-UCD-FARDC-WZ-004.s: Actualite.cd reported that at least four people were killed and valuables destroyed in clashes at Misisi and Lulimba, Fizi territory, between two Wazalendo factions: the CNCCP of commander Yakutumba and the FABB of Ngoma Nzito.
r1-UCD-FARDC-WZ-004.l: Misisi and Lulimba, Fizi territory (Ngandja sector), South Kivu
r1-UCD-FARDC-WZ-004.a: CNCCP (Yakutumba) and FABB (Ngoma Nzito), both Wazalendo factions
r1-UCD-FARDC-WZ-004.n: Article dated 2025-10-26 (the clash date itself is not stated; KMP 30 Oct says fighting began 25 Oct). The page prints the Yakutumba group as 'CNCCP' while Kivu Morning Post and the UN Group of Experts print 'CNPSC'; reviewer should reconcile. Victims are not necessarily civilians: the source does not say.
r1-UCD-FARDC-WZ-004.vn: Excerpt prints toll, places and both factions as named. Actualite.cd prints the Yakutumba group as 'CNCCP'; Kivu Morning Post prints 'CNPSC'. Variants kept as printed; identity not asserted. The source does not say whether the dead were civilians.
src: Au moins quatre personnes ont été tuées et plusieurs biens de valeur détruits lors des affrontements survenus à Misisi et Lulimba, dans le territoire de Fizi (Sud-Kivu), entre deux factions des Wazalendo : la CNCCP du commandant Yakutumba et la FABB de Ngoma Nzito.

r1-UCD-FARDC-WZ-005.s: Actualite.cd reported that the Fizi territory administrator, Sammy Kalonji Badibanga, confirmed the fighting and gave as its main cause the decision of Yakutumba's men to remove illegal barriers set up in the area.
r1-UCD-FARDC-WZ-005.l: Misisi and Lulimba, Fizi territory, South Kivu
r1-UCD-FARDC-WZ-005.n: Official local attribution of cause; the other faction's account was not found.
r1-UCD-FARDC-WZ-005.vn: Excerpt prints name, post and stated cause. Cause as stated by the territory administrator; the other faction's account not found.
src: L’information a été confirmée par Sammy Kalonji Badibanga, administrateur du territoire de Fizi, qui évoque comme principale cause du conflit la décision des hommes de Yakutumba de supprimer les barrières illégales érigées dans la zone.

r1-UCD-FARDC-WZ-006.s: Kivu Morning Post reported that for more than a week fighting had opposed the Wazalendo of the Coalition nationale du peuple pour la souveraineté du Congo (CNPSC) of William Amuri Yakutumba to certain elements of the Biloze Bishambuke self-defence forces of Kalembe Ngoma Nzito, and quoted an elected official from Uvira, president of the defence and security commission of the provincial assembly, as saying the clashes began on 25 October 2025 and caused loss of life.
r1-UCD-FARDC-WZ-006.a: CNPSC (William Amuri Yakutumba); Biloze Bishambuke (Kalembe Ngoma Nzito)
r1-UCD-FARDC-WZ-006.n: Two excerpts from the same page. Corroborates Actualite.cd 26 Oct 2025 (separate claim) on the parties and adds the 25 Oct start. Name spellings differ across outlets: 'Ngoma Nzito' (Actualite.cd), 'Kalembe Ngoma Nzito' (KMP), 'Delphin Kalembe Ngomanzito' (Enquete.cd), 'Delphin Ngomanzito' (UN Group of Experts); whether they are one person is for the reviewer to check, not asserted here.
r1-UCD-FARDC-WZ-006.vn: The draft attributed the first passage (outlet narration) to the deputy; split narration from the deputy's account and named the deputy, printed on the page. Name variants as printed: 'Ngoma Nzito' (Actualite.cd), 'Kalembe Ngoma Nzito' (Kivu Morning Post), 'Delphin Kalembe Ngomanzito' (Enquete.cd); identity not asserted. 'CNPSC' here vs 'CNCCP' (Actualite.cd). The page names the elected official as provincial deputy Bubasha Tangania David and places the violence at Misisi, Fizi territory.
src: Depuis plus d’une semaine, des combats opposent les éléments Wazalendo de la Coalition nationale du peuple pour la souveraineté du Congo (CNPSC) de William Amuri Yakutumba à certains éléments des forces d’autodéfense Biloze Bishambuke de Kalembe Ngoma Nzito.

Selon cet élu d’Uvira et président de la Commission défense et sécurité de l’Assemblée provinciale du Sud-Kivu, ces affrontements armés, qui ont commencé le 25 octobre 2025, ont causé des pertes en vies humaines et semé la terreur au sein de la population.

r1-UCD-FARDC-WZ-007.s: Kivu Morning Post reported, citing an administrative official at Mwenga Centre, a provisional toll of at least eight dead and five wounded in clashes on Thursday 18 September 2025 between two Wazalendo groups in Mwenga territory.
r1-UCD-FARDC-WZ-007.x: Kivu Morning Post: at least eight dead, five wounded (provisional)
r1-UCD-FARDC-WZ-007.n: Single local outlet; provisional toll from an unnamed administrative official. Victims not stated to be civilians.
r1-UCD-FARDC-WZ-007.vn: Excerpt prints toll, date, place and the official as source. Provisional toll from an unnamed administrative official; victims not stated to be civilians.
src: Au moins huit morts et cinq blessés, bilan provisoire des accrochages hier, jeudi 18 septembre 2025, entre deux groupes wazalendo, selon un responsable administratif à Mwenga Centre, chef-lieu du territoire de Mwenga en province du Sud-Kivu.

r1-UCD-FARDC-WZ-008.s: Kivu Morning Post reported that the Mwenga clashes opposed fighters loyal to self-proclaimed general Malaika and those of general Nyakiliba, and that the pro-Malaika Wazalendo were supported by elements of the Foka Maïk group and of the army.
r1-UCD-FARDC-WZ-008.a: Wazalendo of self-proclaimed general Malaika (with Foka Maïk group and army elements) vs Wazalendo of general Nyakiliba
r1-UCD-FARDC-WZ-008.n: The source says 'de l'armée' without naming a unit. 'Foka Maïk' is printed as a group name; compare existing claim UC-FARDC-020 (Actualite.cd) naming Albert Foka Maik as a former provincial minister, whether the same is not stated by either source.
r1-UCD-FARDC-WZ-008.vn: Excerpt prints names and support as stated. 'de l'armée' without unit; 'Malaika' is described as a self-proclaimed general.
src: Ces violents affrontements ont opposé les combattants fidèles au général autoproclamé Malaika et ceux du général Nyakiliba. Les Wazalendo pro-Malaika étaient soutenus par des éléments du groupe Foka Maïk et de l’armée.

r1-UCD-FARDC-WZ-009.s: Kivu Morning Post reported that the root of the Mwenga clashes was the removal, by the fighters of Malaika and of Foka Maïk, of barriers that Nyakiliba had set up on the RN2.
r1-UCD-FARDC-WZ-009.a: Wazalendo of Nyakiliba, Malaika and Foka Maïk
r1-UCD-FARDC-WZ-009.n: Illegal taxation barriers are a recurrent cause of Wazalendo infighting (see also the Fizi clash, 25 Oct 2025). The page does not call the barriers illegal or taxing.
r1-UCD-FARDC-WZ-009.vn: Excerpt prints the cause as stated.
src: Le nœud du problème réside dans la suppression des barrières érigées sur la RN2 par Nyakiliba, lesquelles ont été démantelées par les combattants de Malaika et de Foka Maïk, provoquant ainsi la colère du camp Nyakiliba.

r1-UCD-FARDC-WZ-010.s: 7sur7.cd reported that the new commander of the Sokola 1 Grand Nord and Front Nord operational sector took up his functions on Wednesday 23 July 2025 in Beni, North Kivu, and that general Mugisa Muleka replaced major-general Nyembo Abdallah, who had led the sector.
r1-UCD-FARDC-WZ-010.l: Beni, North Kivu (Sokola 1 Grand Nord and Front Nord)
r1-UCD-FARDC-WZ-010.a: FARDC Sokola 1 Grand Nord: Gen. Mugisa Muleka (incoming), Maj.-Gen. Nyembo Abdallah (outgoing)
r1-UCD-FARDC-WZ-010.n: Spelling 'Mugisa Muleka' (7sur7.cd, Actualite.cd) vs 'Mugisha Muleka' and 'Joseph Kisembo Muleke' in search-result titles of other outlets (not opened). Existing roster has no entry for this sector command.
r1-UCD-FARDC-WZ-010.vn: Excerpt prints all clauses; the '7' flag comes from the outlet name 7sur7.cd.
src: Le nouveau commandant du secteur opérationnel Sokola 1 Grand Nord et Front Nord a pris ses fonctions ce mercredi 23 juillet 2025 en ville de Beni, dans la province du Nord-Kivu. Le général Mugisa Muleka vient de remplacer le général-major Nyembo Abdallah qui dirigeait ledit secteur.

r1-UCD-FARDC-WZ-011.s: 7sur7.cd reported, citing the recent national defence telegram, that general Nyembo Abdallah was sent to Kisangani to lead the 31st military region based in Tshopo province.
r1-UCD-FARDC-WZ-011.l: Kisangani, Tshopo (outside the Kivus; rotation of the former Sokola 1 commander)
r1-UCD-FARDC-WZ-011.a: FARDC 31st military region: Gen. Nyembo Abdallah
r1-UCD-FARDC-WZ-011.n: Outside the Kivus; recorded as a rotation. The page writes 'Tsopo' (sic) for Tshopo.
r1-UCD-FARDC-WZ-011.vn: Excerpt prints the posting; '7' flag is the outlet name. The page prints 'Tsopo' for Tshopo.
src: Selon le récent télégramme de la défense nationale, le général Nyembo Abdallah est envoyé à Kisangani pour diriger la 31eme région militaire basée dans la province de la Tsopo.

r1-UCD-FARDC-WZ-012.s: Actualite.cd reported that the appointment of general Mugisa Muleka Joseph as the new head of Sokola 1 operations was communicated in a general staff telegram made public on Tuesday 15 July, and that he was previously commander of the 31st Principal Defence Brigade at Mambasa since 17 July 2020.
r1-UCD-FARDC-WZ-012.l: Beni, North Kivu (Sokola 1); previous post Mambasa, Ituri
r1-UCD-FARDC-WZ-012.a: FARDC Sokola 1 Grand Nord: Gen. Mugisa Muleka Joseph
r1-UCD-FARDC-WZ-012.n: Date computed: the page gives 'mardi 15 juillet' without a year; article dated 17 Jul 2025 (year taken from the publication date). The statement 'previously commander ... since 17 July 2020' is the source's wording (start date of the former post).
r1-UCD-FARDC-WZ-012.vn: Both clauses printed on the same page. The page gives 'mardi 15 juillet' without a year; year from the article date.
src: Le Général Mugisa Muleka Joseph est le nouveau commandant du secteur opérationnel Sokola 1 Grand Nord-Kivu, basé à Beni. L'information a été communiquée dans un télégramme de l'état-major général des Forces armées de la République Démocratique du Congo (FARDC), rendu public mardi 15 juillet
Le général Mugisa Muleka, précédemment commandant de la 31ème Brigade de Défense Principale à Mambasa depuis le 17 juillet 2020

r1-UCD-FARDC-WZ-013.s: Congo-Press (MediaCongo Press) reported that major-general Nyembo Abdallah was named commander of the Sukola 1 Grand Nord operational sector and the Front Nord in North Kivu, an official designation announced on 22 May 2025 by the FARDC chief of general staff.
r1-UCD-FARDC-WZ-013.l: North Kivu (Sukola 1 Grand Nord and Front Nord)
r1-UCD-FARDC-WZ-013.a: FARDC Sukola 1 Grand Nord: Maj.-Gen. Nyembo Abdallah
r1-UCD-FARDC-WZ-013.n: Page dated 2025-05-26. The same page says he had three years of experience leading military operations in Ituri and earlier served in Sukola 1 as deputy commander for operations and intelligence (not separately claimed).
r1-UCD-FARDC-WZ-013.vn: Excerpt prints appointment and announcement date.
src: Le général-major Nyembo Abdallah vient d’être nommé commandant du secteur opérationnel Sukola 1 Grand Nord et du Front Nord dans la province du Nord-Kivu, une désignation officielle annoncée le 22 mai 2025 par le chef d’état-major général des FARDC.

r1-UCD-FARDC-WZ-014.s: Actualite.cd reported that the FARDC supported brigadier general Olivier Gasita, contested by the Wazalendo and struggling to take up his functions as deputy commander of the 33rd military region in charge of military operations and intelligence at Uvira, South Kivu.
r1-UCD-FARDC-WZ-014.l: Uvira city, South Kivu (33rd military region)
r1-UCD-FARDC-WZ-014.a: FARDC 33rd military region: Gen. Olivier Gasita; Wazalendo (contesting)
r1-UCD-FARDC-WZ-014.n: Role differs between sources: Actualite.cd and spokesperson Ekenge say deputy commander (ops and intelligence) of the 33rd military region; Radio Okapi (23 Oct 2025) says he had been sent to fill the vacant post of operational-sector commander. Existing claim UC-FARDC-007 (SOS Médias Burundi) says he remained in post after the October reshuffle; Radio Okapi 23 Oct 2025 links an article titled 'Le général Olivier Gasita quitte Uvira sur fond de manifestations populaires' (not opened). Contradiction left for reviewer.
r1-UCD-FARDC-WZ-014.vn: Excerpt prints support, contestation and role as Actualite.cd states it. Accounts of Gasita's role differ: Actualite.cd and FARDC spokesperson Ekenge say deputy commander of the 33rd military region in charge of operations and intelligence; Radio Okapi (23 Oct 2025) says he had been sent to fill the vacant post of operational-sector commander. Both stated; not reconciled.
src: Les Forces Armées de la République Démocratique du Congo ( FARDC) ont apporté leur soutien au général de brigade Olivier Gasita contesté par les Wazalendo et peine à occuper ses fonctions de commandant adjoint de la 33e région militaire en charge des opérations et renseignements militaires ( Uvira)

r1-UCD-FARDC-WZ-015.s: Actualite.cd reported that, at a press conference in Kinshasa on Saturday 06 September 2025, FARDC spokesperson major-general Sylvain Ekenge said that an officer no longer belongs to his community but to the whole nation.
r1-UCD-FARDC-WZ-015.n: Statement is Ekenge's defence of Gasita against Wazalendo contestation. Rendered via Actualite.cd.
r1-UCD-FARDC-WZ-015.vn: Excerpt prints date, place, speaker and statement.
src: Au cours d'une conférence de presse tenue ce samedi 06 septembre 2025 à Kinshasa, le général major Sylvain Ekenge, porte-parole des FARDC précise qu'un militaire de surcroît un officier n'appartient plus à sa communauté mais plutôt à la nation toute entière.

r1-UCD-FARDC-WZ-016.s: Actualite.cd reported that Sylvain Ekenge said on 6 September 2025 that no other presidential ordinance had relieved Gasita of his function and that he remained deputy commander of the 33rd military region, in charge of military operations and intelligence.
r1-UCD-FARDC-WZ-016.n: Quoted speech as printed by Actualite.cd. Same press conference as the preceding claim.
r1-UCD-FARDC-WZ-016.vn: Quoted speech printed on the page; date and speaker from the first excerpt.
src: Au cours d'une conférence de presse tenue ce samedi 06 septembre 2025 à Kinshasa, le général major Sylvain Ekenge, porte-parole des FARDC précise qu'un militaire de surcroît un officier n'appartient plus à sa communauté mais plutôt à la nation toute entière.

jusqu'à aujourd'hui je vous informe qu'il n'y a aucune autre ordonnance présidentielle qui l'a déchargé de cette fonction, il est, il reste commandant adjoint de la 33e région militaire, il a la charge des opérations militaires et renseignements.

r1-UCD-FARDC-WZ-017.s: Actualite.cd reported that, reacting to Wazalendo allegations that Gasita was close to Rwanda and to the AFC/M23 rebellion, Sylvain Ekenge said Gasita would have another superior in charge of the whole region.
r1-UCD-FARDC-WZ-017.n: This is the FARDC account of an allegation by Wazalendo (an allegation, not established). Radio Okapi (9 Sep 2025, already cited elsewhere) reports Wazalendo suspected him of being a double agent of the M23.
r1-UCD-FARDC-WZ-017.vn: Excerpt prints the reaction to the Wazalendo allegation. The allegation that Gasita was close to Rwanda and the AFC/M23 is the Wazalendo's, reported by Actualite.cd; not established.
src: Réagissant aux allégations de Wazalendo le qualifiant d'être proche du Rwanda et de la rébellion de l'AFC/M23, Sylvain Ekenge précise que Gasita aura à sa tête un autre supérieur qui s'occupe de l'ensemble de la région.

r1-UCD-FARDC-WZ-018.s: Radio Okapi reported that brigadier generals Ilunga Kabamba Jean-Jacques and Amuli Civiri, named respectively commander of the 33rd military region and commander of the Sokola 2 operational sector in South Kivu, arrived in Uvira on Wednesday 22 October 2025 via the Kavimvira border post with Burundi.
r1-UCD-FARDC-WZ-018.a: FARDC 33rd military region (Ilunga Kabamba Jean-Jacques); Sokola 2 (Amuli Civiri)
r1-UCD-FARDC-WZ-018.n: Corroborates existing claim UC-FARDC-005 (7sur7.cd) from an independent outlet; 7sur7.cd prints 'Amuli Civiri'/'AMULI CIVIRI' and Radio Okapi 'Amuli Civiri' while a search snippet printed 'Chiviri Hamuli'/'Chiviri Amuli' (not opened).
r1-UCD-FARDC-WZ-018.vn: Excerpt prints names, posts, date and entry point.
src: Les généraux de brigade Ilunga Kabamba Jean-Jacques et Amuli Civiri ont été nommés respectivement commandant de la 33e région militaire et commandant du secteur opérationnel Sokola 2 au Sud-Kivu. Ils sont arrivés à Uvira le mercredi 22 octobre 2025 par la porte de Kavimvira à la frontière avec le Burundi

r1-UCD-FARDC-WZ-019.s: Radio Okapi reported that the appointments of brigadier generals Ilunga Kabamba and Amuli Civiri as commander of the 33rd military region and commander of the Sokola 2 operational sector followed the death in August of brigade general Mwaku Mbuluku Jean-Daniel, former commander of the 33rd military region, and the replacement of general Mwehu Lumbu Evariste as commander of the operational sector.
r1-UCD-FARDC-WZ-019.l: Uvira, South Kivu (33rd military region; Sokola 2)
r1-UCD-FARDC-WZ-019.a: FARDC 33rd military region (Mwaku Mbuluku Jean-Daniel); Sokola 2 (Mwehu Lumbu Evariste)
r1-UCD-FARDC-WZ-019.n: Month only for the death (the source says 'en août dernier'). Compare existing UC-FARDC-006 (7sur7.cd). The Group of Experts reports that Mwehu Lumbu Evariste commanded Sokola 2 on 22 Aug 2025 (held by the GOE unit).
r1-UCD-FARDC-WZ-019.vn: 'October 2025' was not printed in either excerpt; named the appointments instead. The page prints the first name as 'Ilunga Kabamba Jean-Jacques'.
src: Les généraux de brigade Ilunga Kabamba Jean-Jacques et Amuli Civiri ont été nommés respectivement commandant de la 33e région militaire et commandant du secteur opérationnel Sokola 2 au Sud-Kivu.

Cette nomination fait suite au décès en août dernier du général de brigade Mwaku Mbuluku Jean-Daniel, ancien commandant de la 33e région militaire, et au remplacement du général Mwehu Lumbu Evariste au poste de commandant du secteur opérationnel.

r1-UCD-FARDC-WZ-020.s: Radio Okapi reported that general Olivier Gasita, sent to fill the vacant post of operational sector commander, had been violently contested by the population in demonstrations that resulted in deaths, many wounded and significant material damage.
r1-UCD-FARDC-WZ-020.a: Demonstrators in Uvira; FARDC (Gasita contested); perpetrator of the deaths not attributed
r1-UCD-FARDC-WZ-020.n: Retrospective mention in a 23 Oct 2025 article; the page gives no date for the demonstrations. Radio Okapi 9 Sep 2025 (cited by UV-2025Q3) gives 'at least seven' dead (provisional); this page gives no figure. Role differs from Actualite.cd (deputy commander of the 33rd military region).
r1-UCD-FARDC-WZ-020.vn: Excerpt prints the passage; no date or figure, no perpetrator of the deaths. Radio Okapi describes Gasita's post as operational-sector commander; Actualite.cd and the FARDC spokesperson say deputy commander of the 33rd military region (ops and intelligence). Both stated. The page does not say who caused the deaths.
src: Le général Olivier Gasita qui avait été envoyé pour occuper le poste vacant du commandant secteur opérationnel, avait été violemment contesté par la population à travers des manifestations rudes, qui s’étaient alors soldées par des morts, de nombreux blessés et des dégâts matériels importants.

r1-UCD-FARDC-WZ-021.s: Kivu Morning Post reported that the Iamba health centre at Makobola, in the Nundu health zone, Tanganyika sector, Fizi territory, was pillaged on 30 December, and that, according to concordant sources, the FARDC and Wazalendo militiamen were allegedly responsible.
r1-UCD-FARDC-WZ-021.l: Iamba health centre, Makobola, Nundu health zone, Fizi territory, South Kivu
r1-UCD-FARDC-WZ-021.a: FARDC and Wazalendo (alleged, per concordant sources cited by the outlet)
r1-UCD-FARDC-WZ-021.n: Single local outlet (Goma-based) citing unnamed 'sources concordantes'; year taken from the article date (2025-12-31). The article says the Congolese army had not yet reacted to the accusations.
r1-UCD-FARDC-WZ-021.vn: Excerpt prints the pillage, date and conditional attribution. Attribution to FARDC and Wazalendo is by unnamed 'concordant sources' (conditional 'seraient'); the page says the Congolese army had not yet reacted. 2026-10-28 corroboration pass: corroborated; added 1 source(s) whose excerpts were matched on the live page. Regraded C->B on independent, non-partisan corroboration. 2026-10-29: source 1 excerpt_en edited: QA 0.4 A3: non-English excerpt shown without an English translation; translation added, marked as one
src: Le centre de santé d’Iamba à Makobola, dans la zone de santé de Nundu, secteur de Tanganyika, territoire de Fizi (Sud-Kivu), a été pillé le 30 décembre. Selon des sources concordantes, les FARDC et les miliciens Wazalendo seraient responsables de ces actes.
Lors des désordres cette nuit-là, ces militaires et wazalendo ont dépouillé et saccagé le centre de santé Iàmba, situé dans le sous-village de Bangwe, dans la zone de santé Nundu.

r1-UCD-FARDC-WZ-022.s: Kivu Morning Post reported that structures pillaged at Makobola included the Makobola health centre and a recently built hospital, and quoted another local source as saying that all the equipment of the new building of this large hospital, built but not yet operational, was pillaged.
r1-UCD-FARDC-WZ-022.a: FARDC and Wazalendo (alleged by the outlet's sources in the preceding report; this passage does not itself name the perpetrators)
r1-UCD-FARDC-WZ-022.n: Date approximate: the page puts the looting around the night of 29-30 Dec 2025 in another passage; this excerpt gives no date. Perpetrators are named elsewhere on the page, not in this passage.
r1-UCD-FARDC-WZ-022.vn: Excerpt prints both structures and the quote. This passage does not name perpetrators; the page attributes the pillage to FARDC and Wazalendo per concordant sources. 2026-10-28 corroboration pass: partially_corroborated; added 1 source(s) whose excerpts were matched on the live page. 2026-10-29: source 1 excerpt_en edited: QA 0.4 A3: non-English excerpt shown without an English translation; translation added, marked as one
src: Parmi les structures pillées figurent le centre de santé de Makobola et un hôpital récemment construit. “Tous les matériels du nouveau bâtiment de ce grand hôpital, construit mais non encore opérationnel, ont été pillés” , a ajouté une autre source locale.
D'après des sources sanitaires, les pillards ont nuitamment forcé les portes de centre de santé avant de procéder au pillage.

r1-UCD-FARDC-WZ-023.s: Kivu Morning Post reported that, besides the pillage at Makobola, cases of rape were reported, as lamented by civil society actors who asked to remain anonymous; the same passage says that, according to concordant sources, the FARDC and Wazalendo militiamen were allegedly responsible for the pillage.
r1-UCD-FARDC-WZ-023.a: not attributed by the source for the rapes (the pillage is attributed to FARDC and Wazalendo)
r1-UCD-FARDC-WZ-023.x: Kivu Morning Post: number of rape survivors unknown
r1-UCD-FARDC-WZ-023.n: The page does not give a number of survivors ('Il est difficile de connaître le bilan exact des femmes violées' in a later passage) and does not say who committed the rapes. Anonymous civil-society sources; uncorroborated. Survivors unnamed.
r1-UCD-FARDC-WZ-023.vn: Excerpt prints the rape reports and the pillage attribution; statement keeps them separate. The page does not attribute the rapes to any party and gives no number of survivors; the pillage is attributed to FARDC and Wazalendo by concordant sources. 2026-10-28 corroboration pass: same_origin_only; added 2 source(s) whose excerpts were matched on the live page. 2026-10-29: source 1 excerpt_en edited: QA 0.4 A3: non-English excerpt shown without an English translation; translation added, marked as one 2026-10-29: source 2 excerpt_en edited: QA 0.4 A3: non-English excerpt shown without an English translation; translation added, marked as one
src: Selon des sources concordantes, les FARDC et les miliciens Wazalendo seraient responsables de ces actes. Outre le pillage, des cas de viol ont été signalés, déplorent des acteurs de la société civile qui ont souhaité rester anonymes.

Ils ont forcé les portes des maisons des habitants et emportaient tout ce qu’ils ont trouvé, même la nourriture. Et ils ont obligé les femmes de les aider à transporter et ces dernières devraient regagner leurs maisons après avoir été violées
ainsi que plusieurs femmes ont été violées par ces militaires FARDC et wazalendo dans la cité de Makobola

r1-UCD-FARDC-WZ-024.s: Kivu Morning Post reported that the Mwenga territory civil society forces vives, meeting on Monday 16 March 2026, denounced the harassment committed by FARDC and Wazalendo elements.
r1-UCD-FARDC-WZ-024.a: FARDC and Wazalendo elements (alleged by the territory civil society)
r1-UCD-FARDC-WZ-024.n: Statement by a civil-society body as reported by one local outlet; no FARDC or Wazalendo reply found.
r1-UCD-FARDC-WZ-024.vn: Excerpt prints date, body and denunciation. Civil-society allegation; no FARDC or Wazalendo reply found.
src: Lors d’une réunion tenue le lundi 16 mars 2026 par le bureau de la société civile forces vives du territoire de Mwenga, qui a réuni les délégués représentants de toutes les couches sociales, ces derniers ont dénoncé les tracasseries commises par les éléments FARDC et Wazalendo, en violation de la Constitution.

r1-UCD-FARDC-WZ-025.s: Kivu Morning Post reported, citing the Mwenga civil society, that at the start of March at Musika a nurse was robbed of 200 000 FC, his android phone and his boots, and that on 12 March a young boy was shot ('fusillé par balle') at Ilinda and on the 13th another was shot ('fusillé') at Kibumba; the civil society gave these as examples ('À titre d'exemple') after denouncing harassment by FARDC and Wazalendo elements, but the passage does not name the perpetrator of each incident.
r1-UCD-FARDC-WZ-025.l: Musika, Ilinda and Kibumba, Mwenga territory, South Kivu
r1-UCD-FARDC-WZ-025.a: not attributed by this passage (civil society's complaint targets FARDC and Wazalendo generally)
r1-UCD-FARDC-WZ-025.x: Kivu Morning Post (civil society): one boy shot at Ilinda on the 12th; one boy shot at Kibumba on the 13th
r1-UCD-FARDC-WZ-025.n: The excerpt follows the sentence in which the civil society denounces FARDC and Wazalendo; the page does not state that these specific shootings or the robbery were committed by them. The nurse is a health worker but the page does not say the robbery was linked to his work, so no health tag. 'fusillé par balle' is translated as 'shot dead' per the page's wording. Victims unnamed.
r1-UCD-FARDC-WZ-025.vn: Removed year not printed in the excerpt; kept 'shot' for the second boy as printed ('un autre fusillé'). The page does not attribute these specific incidents to FARDC or Wazalendo. 2026-10-28: source 0 sources.append edited: supports red-team amend: examples given after denouncing FARDC and Wazalendo harassment 2026-10-28: statement edited: red-team rt-023: The statement says the 12 March Ilinda victim was 'shot dead', but 'fusillé par balle' does not by itself say the victim died (Radio Okapi's account of the same incidents uses 'fusillé' and the verifier there declined to say killed); the input's own English gloss over-translates. Also, Radio Okapi identifies the 12 March Ilinda victim as Dodos Ngama, 30, a discrepancy with 'jeune garçon'.; excerpt-support: added 1 excerpt(s): examples given after denouncing FARDC and Wazalendo harassment | replaced 'does not attribute these specific incidents to any party': the page gives them as examples of FARDC and Wazalendo abuses
src: À titre d’exemple, elle rappelle qu’au début du mois de mars, à Musika, un infirmier a été victime du pillage de 200 000 FC, de son téléphone android et de ses godillots. “Le 12 mars, un jeune garçon fusillé par balle à Ilinda et le 13, un autre fusillé à Kibumba.
ces derniers ont dénoncé les tracasseries commises par les éléments FARDC et Wazalendo, en violation de la Constitution.

r1-UCD-FARDC-WZ-026.s: Kivu Morning Post reported that Shabunda civil society, which denounced several recent deadly incidents, said a citizen was beaten to death by Wazalendo elements and that three children aged 10 to 15 were hit by bullets as they left school, one of whom died on the spot.
r1-UCD-FARDC-WZ-026.a: Wazalendo elements (alleged by civil society for the beating; the shooting of the children is not explicitly attributed)
r1-UCD-FARDC-WZ-026.x: Kivu Morning Post: one adult beaten to death; three children aged 10 to 15 hit by bullets, one dead, two treated
r1-UCD-FARDC-WZ-026.n: Date: the article (2026-01-27) says activities have been paralysed 'depuis ce lundi'; the incidents themselves are undated (date computed from weekday and publication date for the paralysis only, so treat as approximate). The children are minors, unnamed. Single local outlet citing the civil society president.
r1-UCD-FARDC-WZ-026.vn: Passage sits within the civil-society president's quoted account on the page. Allegation by Shabunda civil society; the shooting of the children is not attributed to a party in the passage. Incidents undated.
src: La société civile dénonce plusieurs incidents meurtriers récents. Un citoyen a été battu à mort par des éléments Wazalendo. Par ailleurs, trois enfants âgés de 10 à 15 ans ont été atteints par des balles alors qu’ils quittaient l’école ; deux sont soignés et un est décédé sur place.

r1-UCD-FARDC-WZ-027.s: Kivu Morning Post reported that the president of Shabunda civil society, Maître Isaac Kibunda, said that the armed Wazalendo, supposed to support the FARDC on the front lines, were committing serious abuses against the civilian population.
r1-UCD-FARDC-WZ-027.a: Shabunda civil society (Isaac Kibunda) on Wazalendo
r1-UCD-FARDC-WZ-027.n: Date computed from the weekday 'ce lundi' and the publication date 2026-01-27 (the page does not give the date of the call). The allegation is the civil-society leader's, not established.
r1-UCD-FARDC-WZ-027.vn: Excerpt prints name, post and allegation.
src: Selon Maître Isaac Kibunda, président de la société civile de Shabunda, ces combattants armés, censés appuyer les Forces armées de la RDC sur les lignes de front, se livrent à de graves exactions contre la population civile.

r1-UCD-FARDC-WZ-028.s: Kivu Morning Post reported strong tension on the morning of Friday 10 October 2025 in Kamituga, Mwenga territory, caused by a demonstration of residents demanding the immediate departure of Wazalendo fighters accused of multiple abuses in the region.
r1-UCD-FARDC-WZ-028.vn: Excerpt prints date, place and demand.
src: Une vive tension a été observée dans la matinée de ce vendredi 10 octobre 2025 dans la ville de Kamituga, territoire de Mwenga (Sud-Kivu). En cause : une manifestation de la population exigeant le départ immédiat des combattants Wazalendo, accusés de multiples exactions dans la région.

r1-UCD-FARDC-WZ-029.s: Kivu Morning Post quoted the Mwenga territory civil society as giving, for the unrest in Kamituga, a provisional toll of several victims, including PNC elements and a FARDC soldier, as well as wounded civilians and the pillage of shops and phone shops.
r1-UCD-FARDC-WZ-029.a: not attributed in this passage (the demonstration targeted Wazalendo)
r1-UCD-FARDC-WZ-029.x: Kivu Morning Post (civil society): 'plusieurs victimes' incl. PNC elements and a FARDC soldier; civilians wounded (no numbers)
r1-UCD-FARDC-WZ-029.n: The page says 'plusieurs victimes' without separating dead from wounded; the earlier part of the quote (not in the excerpt) describes heavy and light weapons fire from about 23:00 on 9 Oct to the morning of 10 Oct. Perpetrators of the looting not named.
r1-UCD-FARDC-WZ-029.vn: Excerpt prints the civil-society toll as quoted. 'plusieurs victimes' without separating dead from wounded; looters not named.
src: Le bilan provisoire fait état de plusieurs victimes, parmi lesquelles des éléments de la PNC et un militaire FARDC, ainsi que des civils blessés. Des dégâts matériels importants ont également été enregistrés, notamment le pillage de magasins et de boutiques de téléphones » , a déclaré la société civile du territoire de Mwenga.

r1-UCD-FARDC-WZ-030.s: Enquete.cd reported, citing several local sources, that Wazalendo movement leader James Fyeka Adui, arrested in Uvira on 5 September, had been transferred to Kinshasa some days earlier, and that he is accused, according to concordant sources, of involvement in the murder of a civilian in Uvira in May 2026; the outlet added that these accusations had not yet been publicly confirmed in detail by judicial authorities.
r1-UCD-FARDC-WZ-030.a: Wazalendo leader James Fyeka Adui; security services (arresting body not named in this passage)
r1-UCD-FARDC-WZ-030.n: The same page says the accusations have not been publicly confirmed in detail by judicial authorities. Presumption of innocence applies; the allegation is relayed by local sources. The victim of the May 2026 murder is not named. Article dated 2026-09-29; year of the arrest taken from the article date and from La Prunelle RDC (5 Sept 2026).
r1-UCD-FARDC-WZ-030.vn: Added the page's caveat that judicial authorities had not confirmed the accusations. An accusation by local sources, unconfirmed by judicial authorities; not a finding of responsibility.
src: Le leader d’un mouvement des Wazalendo, James Fyeka Adui, arrêté à Uvira le 5 septembre dernier, a été transféré à Kinshasa depuis quelques jours, selon plusieurs sources locales. James Fyeka Adui est accusé, d’après des sources concordantes, d’être impliqué dans le meurtre d’un civil survenu à Uvira au mois de mai 2026.

r1-UCD-FARDC-WZ-031.s: La Prunelle RDC reported that James « Fyeka Adui » was arrested on 5 September 2026 by the security services in Uvira, and that on 6 September contradictory information had circulated about his release, some sources saying he had been released after his hearing and others that he remained detained.
r1-UCD-FARDC-WZ-031.a: Security services (unnamed); Wazalendo commander James « Fyeka Adui »
r1-UCD-FARDC-WZ-031.n: La Prunelle RDC cites the outlet Averticom for part of the background (originating_source set accordingly). The page also mentions an unsigned communiqué attributed to self-defence groups demanding his release and threatening to paralyse Uvira; its authenticity was not established independently (per the page). Gunfire in Uvira on the morning of Wednesday (article dated 2026-09-16) is linked by the outlet to the tensions.
r1-UCD-FARDC-WZ-031.vn: Both clauses printed on the page.
src: James « Fyeka Adui » a été interpellé le 5 septembre 2026 par les services de sécurité à Uvira.

Le 6 septembre, des informations contradictoires avaient circulé au sujet de sa libération. Certaines sources avaient annoncé qu’il avait été relâché après son audition, avant que d’autres informations ne signalent qu’il demeurait détenu.

r1-UCD-FARDC-WZ-032.s: La Prunelle RDC reported that a voice message attributed to James « Fyeka Adui » was circulated on social networks, in which the author accused the commander of the 33rd military region of withholding funds meant for local Wazalendo armed groups; that he was summoned by the military intelligence services of the 33rd military region a few days after the message circulated; and that the Unité spéciale des Wazalendo pour les opérations au Sud-Kivu later announced his suspension as spokesperson.
r1-UCD-FARDC-WZ-032.a: Wazalendo (James « Fyeka Adui », Unité spéciale des Wazalendo pour les opérations au Sud-Kivu); FARDC 33rd military region command (accused)
r1-UCD-FARDC-WZ-032.n: An accusation voiced in an audio (authorship 'attributed'), reported second-hand; the commander is not named on the page and the accusation is unverified. The page, citing the outlet Averticom, also reports a 20 May 2026 summons by 33rd-region military intelligence and says the suspension letter is dated 25 May 2026. Not a finding about any commander.
r1-UCD-FARDC-WZ-032.vn: The draft's 'in May 2026' and 'in a letter' were not in the excerpts; supplied from page passages, kept 'attributed'. The summons document is cited by the page via Averticom. An accusation in an audio of attributed authorship; the commander is not named and the accusation is unverified. The page dates the summons document 20 May 2026 (via Averticom) and the suspension correspondence 25 May 2026.
ent: Unité spéciale des Wazalendo pour les opérations au Sud-Kivu
src: Dans cet enregistrement, l’auteur accusait le commandant de la 33ᵉ Région militaire de retenir des fonds destinés aux groupes armés locaux Wazalendo.
Quelques jours après cette affaire, l’ Unité spéciale des Wazalendo pour les opérations au Sud-Kivu avait annoncé la suspension de James « Fyeka Adui » de ses fonctions de porte-parole.

r1-UCD-FARDC-WZ-033.s: Enquete.cd reported that Delphin Kalembe Ngomanzito, head of the Wazalendo special unit, issued a firm call on Monday 5 May 2026 in Uvira for Wazalendo fighters to withdraw from urban areas and join the front lines, after meeting Jacques Kongolo, adviser to the President of the Republic.
r1-UCD-FARDC-WZ-033.n: Weekday inconsistency: the page prints 'lundi 5 mai 2026' but 5 May 2026 was a Tuesday; the printed date is kept. Wazalendo are a non-state/de facto party; classified here as a party statement. The name is printed 'Delphin Kalembe Ngomanzito' here, 'Delphin Ngomanzito' by the UN Group of Experts and 'Ngoma Nzito' / 'Kalembe Ngoma Nzito' by Actualite.cd and Kivu Morning Post; identity not asserted.
r1-UCD-FARDC-WZ-033.vn: Both excerpts on the page; 'responsable de l'unité spéciale' is the article's description of Delphin Kalembe Ngomanzito. The page prints 'lundi 5 mai 2026' although 5 May 2026 was a Tuesday; kept as printed. Name variants (Delphin Kalembe Ngomanzito, Kalembe Ngoma Nzito, Ngoma Nzito) kept as printed; identity not asserted.
src: Dans ce contexte, Delphin Kalembe Ngomanzito a lancé un appel ferme au retrait des combattants Wazalendo des zones urbaines, tout en plaidant pour une cohabitation pacifique entre les communautés.

Dans une déclaration faite lundi 5 mai 2026 à Uvira, à l’issue d’un entretien avec Jacques Kongolo, conseiller du président de la République en charge des questions communautaires et identitaires dans l’est du pays, le responsable de l’unité spéciale des Wazalendo a exhorté les combattants présents en ville à rejoindre les lignes de front.

r1-UCD-FARDC-WZ-034.s: Enquete.cd reported that a three-day moratorium was granted to Wazalendo fighters in Uvira to leave the city and return to combat positions, with only commanders allowed to circulate in the urban area in strictly limited numbers, and that any breach would expose offenders to the sanctions of military regulations.
r1-UCD-FARDC-WZ-034.a: Wazalendo special unit (Delphin Kalembe Ngomanzito, per the article's framing)
r1-UCD-FARDC-WZ-034.n: The passage is in the passive voice; the page does not say who granted the moratorium (Wazalendo leader, FARDC or provincial authority). A YouTube/Instagram snippet (not opened) attributes the moratorium to Ngomanzito. Recorded as reported, without attributing the grant.
r1-UCD-FARDC-WZ-034.vn: Excerpt prints the moratorium in the passive voice; grantor not stated and not inferred. The page does not say who granted the moratorium.
src: Un moratoire de trois jours a été accordé aux combattants pour quitter la ville et regagner les positions de combat. Seuls les commandants seront autorisés à circuler en zone urbaine, avec un effectif strictement limité. Toute infraction à ces directives exposera les contrevenants à des sanctions prévues par le règlement militaire.

r1-UCD-FARDC-WZ-035.s: Radio Okapi reported, citing several concordant local sources, that Wazalendo allied to the FARDC, under the command of Jams Mutayomba and Noah Maachano, had reportedly also retaken on Monday morning several positions previously held by the AFC/M23, with Nyakigano, Nkokwe and Kashovu, around Kasake, notably cited.
r1-UCD-FARDC-WZ-035.l: Nyakigano, Nkokwe and Kashovu near Kasake, Masisi territory, North Kivu
r1-UCD-FARDC-WZ-035.a: Wazalendo allied to FARDC (Jams Mutayomba, Noah Maachano)
r1-UCD-FARDC-WZ-035.n: Date computed from the weekday 'ce lundi' and the article date 2026-10-05. The same article says the available information does not allow independent establishment of the evolution of control. Names are printed 'Jams Mutayomba' and 'Noah Maachano'. AFC/M23's account not found.
r1-UCD-FARDC-WZ-035.vn: Restored the source's conditional ('auraient'). Radio Okapi says the available information does not allow independent establishment of control. AFC/M23 account not found. 2026-10-29: control edited: Frontline data fix (FRONTLINE_NOTES.md): control.held_by names only the holder (for a withdrawal, the side withdrawing), so the side class is not 'both sides named'; the other side stays in the statement. Wording from the stored excerpt.
src: D’après plusieurs sources locales concordantes, les Wazalendo alliés aux FARDC, sous le commandement de Jams Mutayomba et Noah Maachano, auraient également repris ce lundi matin plusieurs positions jusque-là occupées par l’AFC/M23. Les localités de Nyakigano, Nkokwe et Kashovu, dans les environs de Kasake, sont notamment citées.

r1-UCD-FARDC-WZ-036.s: Radio Okapi reported, after fighting reported on Sunday in Kalehe territory, South Kivu, that sources close to the Congolese army claimed the Wazalendo had retaken several villages in the Ziralo grouping, notably Katale, Shanje and Chambombo, near Lumbishi.
r1-UCD-FARDC-WZ-036.l: Katale, Shanje and Chambombo, Ziralo grouping, near Lumbishi, Kalehe territory, South Kivu
r1-UCD-FARDC-WZ-036.a: Wazalendo (per sources close to the Congolese army)
r1-UCD-FARDC-WZ-036.n: The page gives no date for this claim; the article is dated 2026-10-05 and refers to Kalehe fighting 'dimanche' (date not computed here). The article cautions that available information does not allow independent confirmation. Compare existing claim UC-FARDC-015 on arms handed to Wazalendo at Lumbishi.
r1-UCD-FARDC-WZ-036.vn: Kalehe/South Kivu are not in the excerpt; supplied from the page's Kalehe paragraph. Claim by sources close to the FARDC; Radio Okapi says control could not be independently established.
src: Des sources proches de l’armée congolaise affirment que les Wazalendo ont repris plusieurs villages dans le groupement de Ziralo, notamment Katale, Shanje et Chambombo, près de Lumbishi.

r1-UCD-FARDC-WZ-037.s: Radio Okapi reported that two people died in an exchange of fire in the night of Sunday 24 May in the town of Runingu, Uvira territory, between two Wazalendo groups, each led by its own commander, said to disagree over a question not yet elucidated.
r1-UCD-FARDC-WZ-037.a: Two Wazalendo groups, each under its own commander (not named by the source)
r1-UCD-FARDC-WZ-037.n: Year (2026) from the article date 2026-05-25. The page does not say whether the dead were civilians or fighters. Commanders unnamed.
r1-UCD-FARDC-WZ-037.vn: Excerpt prints toll, night, place and the two groups. The page does not say whether the dead were civilians or fighters.
src: Deux personnes ont trouvé la mort lors d’échanges de tirs survenus dans la nuit du dimanche 24 mai, dans la cité de Runingu, territoire d’Uvira (Sud-Kivu). Ces deux groupes Wazalendo, chacun dirigé par son propre commandant, seraient en désaccord autour d’une question encore non élucidée.

r1-UCD-M23-ADMIN-001.s: Kivu Morning Post reported that in two decisions made public on 6 April 2025 the AFC announced appointments of territory administrators, bourgmestres, cité heads and their deputies in North and South Kivu; in North Kivu it named Kulu Musubao Jean-Louis administrator of Lubero territory with Radjabu Kwizera Elie as deputy, Munyandekwe Innocent as bourgmestre of Kirumba assisted by Kavugho Jeanine, and Kahinda Jean-Baptiste as bourgmestre of Kayna with Mumbere Siméon as deputy.
r1-UCD-M23-ADMIN-001.n: Local outlet (Goma) reporting AFC decisions; the page says 'l'AFC' not explicitly 'M23'. Sibling claim covers the South Kivu part of the same decisions. The Lubero and Kayna/Kirumba posts were later reshuffled (see April 2026 claim).
r1-UCD-M23-ADMIN-001.vn: All names, posts and date printed by the excerpts. 'city heads' narrowed to 'cité heads' (chefs de cité). Page (byline La Rédaction) also names Kanyabayonga's Matimano Jean, not in this claim. excerpt_en flags are false positives: the flagged words are English renderings (Mrs, Doctor, Council, Governor's, etc.); translations checked against the excerpts and are faithful.
src: Au Nord-Kivu, Kulu Musubao Jean-Louis a été nommé administrateur du territoire de Lubero, avec Radjabu Kwizera Elie comme adjoint. À Kirumba, Munyandekwe Innocent devient bourgmestre, assisté de Kavugho Jeanine. À Kayna, Kahinda Jean-Baptiste est nommé bourgmestre, avec Mumbere Siméon comme adjoint

Dans deux décisions rendues publiques ce 6 avril 2025, l’AFC souhaite combler le « vide administratif » en instaurant une gouvernance locale composée d’administrateurs de territoire, de bourgmestres, de chefs de cité et de leurs adjoints.

r1-UCD-M23-ADMIN-002.s: Kivu Morning Post reported that in the same two decisions Buseyi Jean-Bosco was named administrator of Kalehe territory with Ndaye Faustine as deputy, Elie Rubabura Espoir named for Kabare assisted by Cikuru Barakaziga, and three new bourgmestres were named for the Bukavu communes of Ibanda, Kadutu and Bagira; Balyahamwabo Paulin became head of the Minova cité.
r1-UCD-M23-ADMIN-002.l: Kalehe, Kabare, Bukavu (Ibanda, Kadutu, Bagira) and Minova (South Kivu)
r1-UCD-M23-ADMIN-002.n: The page does not name the three Bukavu bourgmestres; a search snippet from another outlet (not fetched) names Kadutu and Bagira holders and spells one differently. Names in this claim are spelled as KMP prints them.
r1-UCD-M23-ADMIN-002.vn: Supported as printed. excerpt_en flags are false positives: the flagged words are English renderings (Mrs, Doctor, Council, Governor's, etc.); translations checked against the excerpts and are faithful. The page does not name the three Bukavu bourgmestres. It also names Idjwi (Ntambuka Pascal, Muhanuka Mwezi Amzat) and Walungu appointees, not in this claim.
src: Pour le Sud-Kivu, Buseyi Jean-Bosco est nommé administrateur du territoire de Kalehe, avec Ndaye Faustine comme adjoint. À Kabare, Elie Rubabura Espoir est nommé, assisté de Cikuru Barakaziga.

Dans la ville de Bukavu, trois nouveaux bourgmestres ont été nommés pour les communes d’Ibanda, Kadutu et Bagira. À Minova, un nouveau chef de cité, Balyahamwabo Paulin, prend fonction avec un adjoint.

r1-UCD-M23-ADMIN-003.s: Kivu Morning Post reported that in a decision made public on 11 June 2025 the Conseil de l'Alliance Fleuve Congo reorganised the South Kivu administration, naming Patrick Busu Bwa Ngwi Nshombo governor and Mukiza Nzabinesha Gadi vice-governor in charge of the economy, finance and development, and that Busu succeeded Emmanuel Birato Rwihimba, recalled to new functions within the AFC/M23 coordination.
r1-UCD-M23-ADMIN-003.n: Fills a gap flagged in UC-M23 and SKN-2025Q1 (Busu seen only in snippets). Birato was appointed governor on 28 Feb 2025 per the UN Group of Experts (existing claim). Date is the decision's publication date; swearing-in date not captured from a fetched page.
r1-UCD-M23-ADMIN-003.vn: Supported as printed (byline La Rédaction). excerpt_en flags are false positives: the flagged words are English renderings (Mrs, Doctor, Council, Governor's, etc.); translations checked against the excerpts and are faithful.
src: Dans une décision rendue publique le 11 juin 2025, le Conseil de l’Alliance Fleuve Congo (AFC) a réaménagé l’administration de la province du Sud-Kivu. Deux personnalités ont été désignées : Patrick Busu Bwa Ngwi Nshombo comme Gouverneur et Mukiza Nzabinesha Gadi comme Vice-Gouverneur en charge de l’Économie, des Finances et du Développement.
Le communiqué précise que Patrick Busu succède à Emmanuel Birato Rwihimba, rappelé pour de nouvelles fonctions au sein de la coordination de l’AFC/M23.

r1-UCD-M23-ADMIN-004.s: Kivu Morning Post reported that the AFC decision named Mukiza Nzabinesha Gadi as South Kivu Vice-Governor to fill the vacancy left by the death of Juvénal Gishinge Gasinzira, and that the decisions were signed by Bertrand Bisimwa, president of the M23 and deputy coordinator of the AFC, and approved by Corneille Nangaa Yobeluo, coordinator of the Alliance.
r1-UCD-M23-ADMIN-004.n: Gishinge Gasinzira was named deputy governor on 28 Feb 2025 per the UN Group of Experts (existing claim); the page gives no date or cause of his death. Chain of signature: Bisimwa signs, Nangaa approves, as KMP prints it.
r1-UCD-M23-ADMIN-004.vn: Supported as printed. excerpt_en flags are false positives: the flagged words are English renderings (Mrs, Doctor, Council, Governor's, etc.); translations checked against the excerpts and are faithful. The page gives no date or cause of Gishinge Gasinzira's death.
src: La nomination de Mukiza Nzabinesha Gadi au poste de Vice-Gouverneur compense le vide laissé par le décès de Juvénal Gishinge Gasinzira.
Les décisions, signées par Bertrand Bisimwa, président du M23 et coordonnateur adjoint de l’AFC, ont été approuvées par Corneille Nangaa Yobeluo, coordonnateur de l’Alliance.

r1-UCD-M23-ADMIN-005.s: A text published by Soleil du Graben (which styles itself 'the news portal of eastern DRC') and signed 'Celcom' said that at the first security council meeting of the year, chaired on 6 January 2026 by Governor Patrick BUSU BWA NGWI Nshombo, the vice-governor in charge of financial and development matters, MUKIZA GADI NZABINESHA, who it said had long been blocked in Minembwe, was officially presented to the participants.
r1-UCD-M23-ADMIN-005.n: Single local portal; the headline says the vice-governor arrived 'après 6 mois d'absence'. The site calls AFC-M23 'le mouvement révolutionnaire' and its copy may be relayed from the AFC provincial administration; treat as that side's account. Spelling of the name varies across outlets (Mukiza Nzabinesha Gadi in KMP).
r1-UCD-M23-ADMIN-005.vn: Page signed 'Celcom.', so partisan_afc_m23 and attributed as the AFC/M23 side's text; name spelled as the body prints it ('Gady' was the headline form). excerpt_en flags are false positives: the flagged words are English renderings (Mrs, Doctor, Council, Governor's, etc.); translations checked against the excerpts and are faithful. Party account: the piece ends 'Celcom.' (communication cell) and speaks of the 'mouvement révolutionnaire AFC-M23'. Name variants as printed: 'MUKIZA GADI NZABINESHA' (body), 'Gady Mukiza' (headline), 'Mukiza Nzabinesha Gadi' (Kivu Morning Post, June 2025). The headline says he arrived after 6 months' absence. 2026-10-28: statement edited: fact-check fc1: Soleil du Graben, 7 Jan 2026, text signed 'Celcom' (AFC/M23 provincial communication cell per the claim's origin field). The page calls the site 'Le portail de l'information de l'Est de la RDC'; nothing on the page says it is Bukavu-based, so that qualifier is dropped. The meeting, date, governor and vice-governor clauses match.
src: Le vice-gouverneur, en charge des questions financières et de développement MUKIZA GADI NZABINESHA, qui a été longtemps bloqué à Minembwe, a été officiellement présenté aux membres participants au Conseil.
première réunion du conseil de sécurité pour cette année, présidée par le Gouverneur Patrick BUSU BWA NGWI Nshombo, ce 6 janvier 2026, dans la salle Auditorium de la Femme

r1-UCD-M23-ADMIN-006.s: A text published by Soleil du Graben and signed by a communication cell said that Nicolas Kyalangalilwa took over as head of the Bukavu city hall from Ladys Muganza Wakandwa, in a decision it attributes to the 'mouvement révolutionnaire AFC-M23', at a handover ceremony on Friday 13 March 2026 under Vice-Governor Dunia Masumbuko Bwenge Doux; it said the outgoing mayor had taken the reins of Bukavu in February 2025.
r1-UCD-M23-ADMIN-006.n: The article ends with 'Cellule de Communication', i.e. it reproduces a communications cell's text, probably the provincial or city administration's, so graded as the AFC/M23 side's own account. Kyalangalilwa was 'confirmed' as mayor in the June 2026 reshuffle (see next claim). The page does not say who named the first mayor or the exact date in February 2025.
r1-UCD-M23-ADMIN-006.vn: Signed 'Cellule de Communication.' at the end, so attributed as the AFC/M23 side's text rather than the portal's reporting. excerpt_en flags are false positives: the flagged words are English renderings (Mrs, Doctor, Council, Governor's, etc.); translations checked against the excerpts and are faithful. Party account (signed 'Cellule de Communication'). The same text names the deputy mayor 'Céline Nyota Luhanja'; Radio Maendeleo (June 2026) prints 'Nyota Luandja Celine'. It says Muganza Wakandwa became the governor's deputy director of cabinet.
src: Désormais, la Mairie de Bukavu est dirigée par le Docteur Nicolas Kyalangalilwa. Le nouveau locataire de l’hôtel de Ville était jusque là Directeur de Cabinet Adjoint en charge des questions administratives, politiques et juridiques du Gouverneur du Sud-Kivu Patrick Busu Bwa Ngwi Nshombo en remplacement de Ladys Muganza Wakandwa

La cérémonie de passation des témoins a eu lieu ce vendredi 13 Mars 2026 sous les auspices du Vice-gouverneur en charge des questions administratives, politiques et juridiques Dunia Masumbuko Bwenge Doux
depuis février 2025 lorsqu’il a pris les rênes de Bukavu
Une décision du mouvement révolutionnaire AFC-M23.

r1-UCD-M23-ADMIN-007.s: Radio Maendeleo reported that in Bukavu Nicolas Kyalangalilwa was confirmed as mayor of Bukavu with Nyota Luandja Celine named deputy mayor, Shaka Muhoza, who had been acting, was confirmed bourgmestre of Bagira with Léon Bahaya as deputy, and that Mweze Prisca and Ruremesha Tého were named bourgmestres of Ibanda and Kadutu.
r1-UCD-M23-ADMIN-007.l: Bukavu (Bagira, Ibanda, Kadutu communes), South Kivu
r1-UCD-M23-ADMIN-007.n: Independent second outlet (Bukavu community radio) for the June 2026 decision that Kivu Morning Post also reported (POL-2026 claim on decision N°033/COORDO-PR/AFC-M23/2026). The Radio Maendeleo article is dated 2026-06-08 and says the appointments were made 'depuis le week-end'; date given as month with report date. Territory-level appointments (Idjwi, Kabare, Kalehe, Walungu, Minova) are in the same article but not repeated here.
r1-UCD-M23-ADMIN-007.vn: Supported as printed (byline Etienne Mulindwa); RM says it consulted the decision. excerpt_en flags are false positives: the flagged words are English renderings (Mrs, Doctor, Council, Governor's, etc.); translations checked against the excerpts and are faithful. Name variant: Radio Maendeleo prints the deputy mayor as 'Nyota Luandja Celine'; a Soleil du Graben communication-cell text (March 2026) prints 'Céline Nyota Luhanja'. Radio Maendeleo says the decision came from the Conseil de l'Alliance and was made 'depuis le week-end'.
src: Dans la ville de Bukavu, Nicolas Kyalangalilwa est confirmé au poste de maire. Il sera secondé par Mme Nyota Luandja Celine, nommée maire adjointe. Dans la commune de Bagira, Shaka Muhoza, qui assurait l’intérim, est confirmé comme bourgmestre. Léon Bahaya est nommé bourgmestre adjoint.

À Ibanda, deux nouvelles figures prennent la tête de la commune. Il s’agit de Mme Mweze Prisca, nommée bourgmestre, et de Mutunwa Mbulanga, désigné bourgmestre adjoint. Dans la commune de Kadutu, Ruremesha Tého est nommé bourgmestre tandis que Chikuru Barhakaziga Pascaline occupe désormais le poste de bourgmestre adjointe.

r1-UCD-M23-ADMIN-008.s: Radio Maendeleo reported that Pascal Ntambuka was named administrator of Idjwi territory, Elie Rubabura Espoir was reappointed administrator of Kabare with former national deputy Kasindi Kingombe Benjamin as assistant, Buseyi Jean Bosco was named administrator of Kalehe, and Sengimana Ruhungande Augustin was named head of the Minova cité.
r1-UCD-M23-ADMIN-008.l: Idjwi, Kabare, Kalehe territories and Minova (South Kivu)
r1-UCD-M23-ADMIN-008.n: Kabare's Elie Rubabura Espoir and Kalehe's Buseyi Jean-Bosco were already named in April 2025 (see April 2025 claim), i.e. they were reconfirmed about 14 months later.
r1-UCD-M23-ADMIN-008.vn: Supported as printed. Kivu Morning Post (April 2025) printed the Idjwi appointee as 'Ntambuka Pascal' with 'Muhanuka Mwezi Amzat'; Radio Maendeleo prints 'Muhamuza Mweze Amza'. Whether these are the same person is not established.
src: Dans les territoires, Pascal Ntambuka est nommé administrateur du territoire d’Idjwi avec comme assistant Mwimbirisha Bulikoko René. À Kabare, Elie Rubabura Espoir est reconduit au poste d’administrateur du territoire avec comme assistant Kasindi Kingombe Benjamin, ancien député national.
Pour le territoire de Kalehe, Buseyi Jean Bosco est nommé administrateur avec comme assistant Muhamuza Mweze Amza.
Dans la cité de Minova, Sengimana Ruhungande Augustin est désigné chef de cité

r1-UCD-M23-ADMIN-009.s: Kivu Morning Post reported that Désiré Kisuba Ngabo, until then deputy mayor, became mayor of Goma replacing Julienne Katembo Ndalieni, who was named administrator of Lubero territory, in a reshuffle of administrative cadres signed on 8 April 2026 by the governor of North Kivu, Bahati Musanga Erasto.
r1-UCD-M23-ADMIN-009.n: Discrepancy to surface: KMP names the outgoing mayor 'Julienne Katembo Ndalieni' and dates the signing 8 April 2026; KMP's November 2025 article calls the mayor 'Katembo Julien Dalieni' and the UN Group of Experts (S/2026/466, already cited by other claims) is reported to give 'Katembo Ndalieni Julien' and 9 April 2026 as the order's date. One person, spelling and date differ by source.
r1-UCD-M23-ADMIN-009.vn: Name, post and date printed by the excerpt; name variant kept as printed and flagged. excerpt_en flags are false positives: the flagged words are English renderings (Mrs, Doctor, Council, Governor's, etc.); translations checked against the excerpts and are faithful. Discrepancy: this article (byline Kethia Rugamika) names the outgoing Goma mayor 'Julienne Katembo Ndalieni'; Kivu Morning Post's 24 November 2025 article names the Goma mayor 'Katembo Julien Dalieni'. Both forms are kept as printed; the sources do not settle the spelling or first name. KMP cites provincial order n°011/014/CAB/GP-NK/2026.
src: À Goma, Désiré Kisuba Ngabo, jusque-là maire adjoint, prend la tête de la mairie de Goma, en remplacement de Julienne Katembo Ndalieni, nommée administrateur du territoire de Lubero. Cette nomination s’inscrit dans un vaste mouvement de permutation des cadres de l’administration publique, signé le 8 avril 2026 par le gouverneur du Nord-Kivu, Bahati Musanga Erasto.

r1-UCD-M23-ADMIN-010.s: Kivu Morning Post reported that in the same April 2026 reshuffle Juvénal Nshimimana became deputy mayor of Goma and Katembo Isevisya became deputy bourgmestre of Goma commune, Radjabu Kwizera Elie head of Karisimbi commune, Innocent Munyandekwe Fizi assistant administrator of Lubero territory and Jeannine Kavugho bourgmestre of Kirumba commune.
r1-UCD-M23-ADMIN-010.l: Goma (Goma and Karisimbi communes), Lubero (North Kivu)
r1-UCD-M23-ADMIN-010.n: Several of these people appear in April 2025 appointments under different posts (Radjabu Kwizera Elie as assistant administrator of Lubero; Munyandekwe Innocent as Kirumba bourgmestre; Kavugho Jeanine as his deputy): rotation of the same cadres. The provincial order is cited by KMP as n°011/014/CAB/GP-NK/2026 (number as printed).
r1-UCD-M23-ADMIN-010.vn: Supported as printed; same page as claim 8. Spellings differ from April 2025 KMP ('Munyandekwe Innocent', 'Kavugho Jeanine'); kept as printed.
src: Juvénal Nshimimana devient maire adjoint de Goma, tandis que Katembo Isevisya est nommé bourgmestre adjoint de la commune de Goma. Radjabu Kwizera Elie prend la tête de la commune de Karisimbi, Innocent Munyandekwe Fizi devient administrateur assistant du territoire de Lubero, et Jeannine Kavugho est nommée bourgmestre de la commune de Kirumba.

r1-UCD-M23-ADMIN-011.s: Kivu Morning Post reported on 24 November 2025 that the spokesperson of the North Kivu governor confirmed that Goma mayor Katembo Julien Dalieni, appointed by the AFC/M23, had been suspended for 15 days, the decision citing a 'manquement grave aux valeurs de la révolution' without further detail.
r1-UCD-M23-ADMIN-011.n: The article adds that the suspension followed a video on social media said to show the mayor hitting a bus driver; that sentence is not in this excerpt and is not asserted here. Mayor returned to office afterwards (an article of 2026 still treats him as mayor until the April 2026 reshuffle); the reinstatement date was not found.
r1-UCD-M23-ADMIN-011.vn: Supported; spokesperson not named on the page. excerpt_en flags are false positives: the flagged words are English renderings (Mrs, Doctor, Council, Governor's, etc.); translations checked against the excerpts and are faithful. Name as printed here: 'Katembo Julien Dalieni'; KMP's April 2026 article prints 'Julienne Katembo Ndalieni'. Lead: the article (byline Blaise Basabose) says the suspension came after a video circulated on social media showing the mayor hitting a bus driver; this is not asserted in the claim.
src: Le maire de Goma, Katembo Julien Dalieni, nommé par l’AFC/M23, a été suspendu pour 15 jours, a confirmé ce lundi 24 novembre le porte-parole du gouverneur du Nord-Kivu contacté par Kivu Morning Post . Selon cette source, la décision évoque un « manquement grave aux valeurs de la révolution » , sans autre précision.

r1-UCD-M23-ADMIN-012.s: Kivu Morning Post reported that North Kivu governor Bahati Musanga Erasto signed on 1 April 2026 a provincial order designating new neighbourhood chiefs and deputies in the city of Goma, aimed at strengthening local governance.
r1-UCD-M23-ADMIN-012.l: Goma (Goma and Karisimbi communes), North Kivu
r1-UCD-M23-ADMIN-012.a: North Kivu governor Bahati Musanga Erasto (named as the AFC/M23 governor by Actualité.cd, 1 Feb 2026, in this unit; this page does not mention AFC/M23)
r1-UCD-M23-ADMIN-012.n: The article lists about 19 quarter chiefs by name (e.g. Himbi, Mapendo, Majengo, Ndosho, Mugunga, Bujovu); not itemised here. The UN Group of Experts annex quoted elsewhere shows overlapping names (Bahemuke Célestin for Bujovu).
r1-UCD-M23-ADMIN-012.vn: Statement supported; actor narrowed because this page never names AFC/M23. excerpt_en flags are false positives: the flagged words are English renderings (Mrs, Doctor, Council, Governor's, etc.); translations checked against the excerpts and are faithful. The page lists the quarter chiefs by name for Goma and Karisimbi communes (e.g. Célestin Bahemuke at Bujovu).
src: Le gouverneur du Nord-Kivu, Bahati Musanga Erasto, a signé le 1er avril 2026 un arrêté provincial portant désignation des nouveaux chefs de quartiers et de leurs adjoints dans la ville de Goma, visant à renforcer la gouvernance locale et soutenir les efforts de consolidation de la paix.

r1-UCD-M23-ADMIN-013.s: Kivu Morning Post reported that North Kivu vice-governor Amani Bahati Chadrack published a circular (n° 01-009-CAB-GP-NK-2025, dated 18 August 2025) banning unjustified price rises for cement in Goma and its surroundings and officially fixing sale prices.
r1-UCD-M23-ADMIN-013.a: Amani Bahati Chadrack, vice-governor of North Kivu (as Kivu Morning Post names him; the page does not say who appointed him)
r1-UCD-M23-ADMIN-013.n: Shows Amani Bahati Chadrack (also printed Chadrack Amani Bahati and Amani Bahati Shaddrak elsewhere) in post as vice-governor in August 2025; the UN Group of Experts (S/2026/466) describes him as Vice-Governor in charge of finance, economy and development. He was named in the original 5 Feb 2025 appointments per other outlets, not verified here.
r1-UCD-M23-ADMIN-013.vn: Actor narrowed to what the page prints. excerpt_en flags are false positives: the flagged words are English renderings (Mrs, Doctor, Council, Governor's, etc.); translations checked against the excerpts and are faithful. The page does not mention AFC/M23; Kinshasa named its own North Kivu vice-governor (Louis Segond Karawa, March 2025), so the AFC/M23 link rests on other sources. The page says the circular was made public on 20 August and fixed a 50 kg bag at 10 USD wholesale and 10.2 USD retail.
src: Pour faire face à la flambée du prix du ciment à Goma et dans ses environs, le vice-gouverneur du Nord-Kivu, Amani Bahati Chadrack, a publié une note circulaire interdisant toute hausse injustifiée et fixant officiellement les prix de vente. Cette note, identifiée sous le numéro 01-009-CAB-GP-NK-2025 du 18 août 2025, est adressée à

r1-UCD-M23-ADMIN-014.s: Kivu Morning Post reported that by an order signed on Monday 8 September 2025 North Kivu governor Bahati Musanga Erasto named seven members of a Commission Provinciale de Pacification et Résolution des Conflits (CPRC), created by an order of 22 August 2025 and presented as a body for pacification in the 'liberated' zones, and that the governor's director of cabinet, Nsanzamahoro Tengera Vincent, was charged with executing the orders.
r1-UCD-M23-ADMIN-014.a: North Kivu governor Bahati Musanga Erasto (named as the AFC/M23 governor by Actualité.cd, 1 Feb 2026, in this unit)
r1-UCD-M23-ADMIN-014.n: 'Liberated' is the AFC/M23 term as quoted by KMP. Seven member names are printed on the page but not itemised here.
r1-UCD-M23-ADMIN-014.vn: Statement supported; actor tied to the printed name rather than inferred. excerpt_en flags are false positives: the flagged words are English renderings (Mrs, Doctor, Council, Governor's, etc.); translations checked against the excerpts and are faithful. The page lists the seven members by name (e.g. Badaga Bigirimana Jean, Mboneza Ndizihiwe Patrice).
ent: Commission Provinciale de Pacification et Résolution des Conflits (CPRC)
src: Par un arrêté signé ce lundi 8 septembre 2025, le Gouverneur du Nord-Kivu, Bahati Musanga Erasto, a officialisé la nomination de sept membres de la Commission Provinciale de Pacification et Résolution des Conflits (CPRC), un organe chargé de promouvoir le dialogue et la cohésion sociale dans la province.
Cette étape s’inscrit dans la logique de l’arrêté signé le 22 août 2025, qui avait acté la création de cette commission, annoncée comme un outil de pacification dans les zones “libérées”.
Le Directeur de Cabinet du Gouverneur, Nsanzamahoro Tengera Vincent, est chargé de l’exécution de ces arrêtés.

r1-UCD-M23-ADMIN-015.s: Actu26 reported that Ephrem Kabasha, described as the new administrator of Rutshuru territory recently appointed by the AFC/M23, sought to reassure transport operators and the population about the security situation in the Busendo area and announced he would hold discussions with the high military hierarchy to strengthen security arrangements on that axis.
r1-UCD-M23-ADMIN-015.n: Small local outlet (Goma); appointment date not given on the page. The Kabasha appointment is not in the April 2026 Goma order and its date and decision were not found. Related incident in the next claim.
r1-UCD-M23-ADMIN-015.vn: Supported (byline Obadias Kanoba). Figures flag '26' is the outlet's name, not a figure.
src: Le nouvel administrateur du territoire de Rutshuru, Ephrem Kabasha, récemment nommé par l’AFC/M23, a tenu à rassurer les opérateurs de transport et la population sur la situation sécuritaire dans la zone de Busendo
Ephrem Kabasha a annoncé son intention d’engager des discussions avec la haute hiérarchie militaire afin de renforcer les dispositifs sécuritaires sur cet axe stratégique

r1-UCD-M23-ADMIN-016.s: Actu26 reported that on the Monday before its report violence at Rumangabo was marked by reported looting of property, and that people were wounded by gunfire on the Goma-Rutshuru road; the page does not name the perpetrators.
r1-UCD-M23-ADMIN-016.l: Rumangabo and Goma-Rutshuru road (Rutshuru, North Kivu)
r1-UCD-M23-ADMIN-016.n: Date computed from weekday and publication date (Monday before Wednesday 25 March 2026 = 23 March). Figures and perpetrators not given.
r1-UCD-M23-ADMIN-016.vn: Supported; date computed, so flagged approximate. Figures flag '26' is the outlet's name. Date derived: 'lundi dernier' in an article of Wednesday 25 March 2026, i.e. 23 March 2026. No perpetrator, figures or victims named.
src: violences survenues le lundi dernier à Rumangabo, où des cas de pillage de biens ont été signalés, ainsi que des personnes blessées par balles sur la route reliant Goma à Rutshuru

r1-UCD-M23-ADMIN-017.s: Kivu Morning Post reported that an order designated Maître Jean-Philippe Chubaka Mashamba head of the Department of Justice and Human Rights, with Maître Shyaka Jean-Paul in charge of judicial reforms and Maître Mugisa Tibasima Emmanuel in charge of human rights as deputy heads of department.
r1-UCD-M23-ADMIN-017.n: Lead for investigators: the de facto human-rights/justice focal points for complaints in AFC/M23 areas. Date of the order itself not given; date is the article date.
r1-UCD-M23-ADMIN-017.vn: Date corrected from the article date (6 Aug) to the announcement date the page prints (5 Aug 2026); AFC-M23 as issuer is in the actor field and the page title. excerpt_en flags are false positives: the flagged words are English renderings (Mrs, Doctor, Council, Governor's, etc.); translations checked against the excerpts and are faithful. KMP says the AFC-M23 announced the designations on Wednesday 5 August 2026, in a decision signed by Bertrand Bisimwa and approved by Corneille Nangaa Yobeluo.
src: Selon cet arrêté, Maître Jean-Philippe Chubaka Mashamba est désigné chef du département de la Justice et des Droits humains. Deux responsables ont également été nommés chefs de département adjoints. Maître Shyaka Jean-Paul est chargé des réformes judiciaires, tandis que Maître Mugisa Tibasima Emmanuel est chargé des droits humains.

r1-UCD-M23-ADMIN-018.s: Actualité.cd reported that the death toll of at least 226 in the collapse at the Rubaya coltan mine in Masisi territory was confirmed to it by Kambere Muyisa Lumumba, whom it described as spokesperson of the North Kivu governor appointed by the AFC/M23 rebellion.
r1-UCD-M23-ADMIN-018.x: Actualité.cd, via AFC/M23 governor spokesperson: at least 226 dead
r1-UCD-M23-ADMIN-018.n: Included for the spokesperson role (first one found for the de facto North Kivu governor in 2026). Figures: 226 at least, per the spokesperson via Actualité.cd; other sources may differ.
r1-UCD-M23-ADMIN-018.vn: Supported; attribution chain preserved. excerpt_en flags are false positives: the flagged words are English renderings (Mrs, Doctor, Council, Governor's, etc.); translations checked against the excerpts and are faithful. The toll is the de facto authority spokesperson's figure as relayed by Actualité.cd (byline Clément Muamba); the page adds that local sources say the real toll could be higher. Date is the article date; the page does not give the collapse date.
src: Au moins 226 personnes sont mortes dans un effondrement survenu à la mine de coltan de Rubaya, située dans le territoire de Masisi, au Nord-Kivu. L’information a été confirmée à ACTUALITÉ.CD par Kambere Muyisa Lumumba, porte-parole du gouverneur de la province du Nord-Kivu nommé par la rébellion de l’AFC/M23.

r1-UCD-M23-ADMIN-019.s: Radio Okapi reported that President Félix Tshisekedi appointed commissioner Louis Segond Karawa vice-governor of North Kivu on Friday 7 March 2025, in the context of the occupation of Goma by the M23, and that he had been South Kivu provincial police commissioner from 2015.
r1-UCD-M23-ADMIN-019.n: Government-side counterpart of the AFC/M23 administration (military governor Somo Kakule, existing claims). Radio Okapi describes the M23 as 'soutenus par l'armée rwandaise' (its own wording).
r1-UCD-M23-ADMIN-019.vn: Supported; 'occupation ... by the M23' and 'soutenus par l'armée rwandaise' are Radio Okapi's wording. excerpt_en flags are false positives: the flagged words are English renderings (Mrs, Doctor, Council, Governor's, etc.); translations checked against the excerpts and are faithful.
src: Le président de la République Démocratique du Congo, Félix Tshisekedi, a nommé le commissaire Louis Segond Karawa en tant que vice-gouverneur de la province du Nord-Kivu, vendredi 7 mars. Cette décision s'inscrit dans un contexte de crise, marqué par l'occupation de Goma, chef-lieu de la province, et d'autres localités par les rebelles du M23, soutenus par l'armée rwandaise.
il est nommé commissaire provincial adjoint chargé de la Police d'appui et de la gestion au Sud-Kivu en 2013. En 2015, il devient commissaire provincial de la police dans cette même province.

r1-UCD-M23-ADMIN-020.s: Actualité.cd reported that Uvira city mayor Kifara Kapenda Kiki, who had returned to Uvira on Thursday, said that those who had occupied the city had left Uvira but 'ils ne sont pas loin', and acknowledged abuses ('dérives') both within the FARDC and among the wazalendo self-defence groups during the fighting.
r1-UCD-M23-ADMIN-020.a: Government of the DRC (Uvira city mayor)
r1-UCD-M23-ADMIN-020.n: Date computed from weekday ('jeudi') and publication date 23 January 2026 (Friday). The mayor's term in office predates the M23 capture; he is already named in UV-2025Q3. Gives the Kinshasa-side civilian account; the M23 side's account of Uvira is covered by other units.
r1-UCD-M23-ADMIN-020.vn: Supported; 'acknowledged dérives' is Actualité.cd's paraphrase of the mayor, followed by his quote. Date derived from 'jeudi' in an article of Friday 23 January 2026. The mayor also said the rebels had looted everything and targeted State symbols, and that some people posing as soldiers looted the population (his account).
src: Le maire de la ville d’Uvira Kifara Kapenda Kiki qui est retourné jeudi s’est exprimé sur l’évolution de la situation sécuritaire, le retour de l’administration publique et la reprise progressive des activités.
